plugins.description: Workspace-level MCP server manager for DeepSeek Harness: one profile-scoped server registry, per-workspace selection, managed from a sidebar panel.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mcp-mgr

**One MCP registry for the whole profile** — declare an MCP server once, choose it per workspace, and manage every server from a panel in the DeepSeek Harness sidebar.

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/releases)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-mcp-mgr/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.19-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

> If this plugin saves you a round of hand-editing JSON, a ⭐ star helps the next person find it.

## Why this exists

MCP servers are declared per workspace, so the same server description gets copied into every workspace file that needs it — and drifts. This plugin splits the two questions that were tangled together:

| Question | Where it is answered now |
|---|---|
| *What servers exist?* | once, in a profile-scoped registry |
| *Which ones does this workspace use?* | a `use` list in that workspace's file |

Servers move between the two files without translation, both stay hand-editable, and a workspace that never adopts the plugin keeps working exactly as before: a missing `use` means its inline `mcpServers` mount as they always did.

## Screenshots

![The MCP Servers panel: the global server registry](docs/images/mcp-servers-panel.png)

*Global servers — add, edit, delete, enable or disable a server, with the profile-level `mcp-client` registrations shown as read-only rows.*

![The Workspaces tab: per-workspace server selection](docs/images/mcp-servers-workspaces.png)

*Workspaces — which global servers each workspace selects, plus its own local servers, dangling references and parse errors.*

## The two files

```
<profile>/.dsh/dshmm/mcp-servers.json     every server definition, shared
<workspace>/.dsh/dshmm/mcp.json           `use: [...]` selects from it,
                                          and may still declare inline servers
```

A selected global server mounts once for the whole profile; inline servers mount per workspace. Strict mode mounts only the active workspace's servers.

## Features

| Surface | What it does |
|---|---|
| Sidebar row | sits directly under **Plugins** (`order: 1`) and opens the **MCP Servers** page in the centre column |
| Global servers tab | the registry: add / edit / delete / enable a server, plus the profile-level `mcp-client` registrations as read-only rows |
| Workspaces tab | per-workspace selection as checkboxes, each workspace's own local servers, dangling references, parse errors |
| JSON editing | paste a whole `mcpServers` object or one server's JSON; the host validates it and reports per-entry errors |
| Bulk import | import several servers at once, answering its own report |
| Tools | servers are registered through `mcp-client`; workspace tools use the `mcp__<serverName>__<tool>` convention |
| Panel polish | optimistic selection toggles, a 60-second background refresh, tab and scroll position preserved across reloads, and a version chip carrying the installed plugin version |

## Requirements

- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- A DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` installation (the plugin composes into a profile)
- `pnpm` 11.8.0 (`packageManager` in the root manifest pins it)

## Installation

Build both packages, pack them and hand them to the profile:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check                        # typecheck → build → verify, both packages
sh tools/install-into-profile.sh desktop
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards; the sidebar entry appears directly under **Plugins**.

There are two packages, and both are Loader rows of their own:

| Package | Role |
|---|---|
| `dsh-mcp-mgr` | the host half: the registry, the sync layer, and the `mcpMgr` Typert Remote contract |
| `dsh-mcp-mgr-ui` | the browser half: the sidebar row and the page it opens |

Installing the host alone leaves the sidebar row without the page it opens, so the two are built and installed together. The packages are not on npm: the profile installs them from this repository.

`dsh plugin` (a pnpm passthrough into the profile directory) is what the script uses; the Plugins page does the same thing. The desktop profile is owned by the Electron application, so `dsh --profile desktop` itself refuses to compose it, while `dsh plugin` still works.

## Quick start

1. Open **MCP Servers** in the sidebar.
2. On **Global servers**, add a server — by form or by pasting JSON:

   ```json
   {
     "shared-http-server": {
       "type": "http",
       "url": "https://mcp.example.com/mcp"
     }
   }
   ```

3. Switch to **Workspaces** and tick that server for the workspaces that should see it.
4. Restart, or let the panel's refresh confirm the new snapshot; the server's tools appear as `mcp__shared-http-server__*`.

## Configuration

Rules that apply to either file:

- a missing `type` is treated as Streamable HTTP; `${VAR}` expansion is supported;
- a stdio server without `cwd` uses the workspace root;
- `serverName` must match `^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,32}$` and is globally unique — duplicates surface as conflicts;
- `"enabled": false` disables an entry without removing it; absent means enabled.

The profile registry is created on the first save from the panel. Neither file has to be created by hand.

## Remote surface

Fourteen methods on the `mcpMgr` namespace, declared once in `src/typert.descriptors.ts` and wrapped as the host manifest and the browser contribution, so the two faces cannot disagree about a wire name or a codec:

| Method | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `version` | this package's installed version, for the title chip |
| `snapshot` | the whole management view |
| `setStrictMode` · `setActiveWorkspace` | gateway state, answering the refreshed snapshot |
| `apply` · `removeServer` · `setServerEnabled` | workspace-local servers |
| `saveGlobalServer` · `saveGlobalServerJson` · `removeGlobalServer` · `setGlobalServerEnabled` | the global registry |
| `setWorkspaceSelection` · `importLocalServer` | which servers a workspace selects |
| `importJson` | bulk import, answering its own report |

## Caveats

- **"Connected" means the tools are registered** (`mcp__<name>__*` present in the tool registry), not that the network is live. `mcp-client` exposes no live connection state, so a real disconnect cannot be detected without changing dsh itself. A connection that drops keeps its last tool generation and reconnects with backoff.
- **The refresh button re-reads the host's last snapshot**; it does not probe.
- The plugin polls no registry and offers no self-update: the panel shows its installed version, and updating means rebuilding and reinstalling it here.

## License and attribution

MIT — see [LICENSE](LICENSE). The host and UI packages derive from `dsh-mcp-mgr` 0.2.0 by **yangfch3** (MIT); that copyright line is kept in the LICENSE file, and this repository is an independent, source-built rewrite rather than a vendored copy of the published bundle.

The panel registers into the same slots dsh's own pages use (`sidebar.panellist` and `main`), and follows the platform's `STYLES.md` contract for page geometry and the version chip.

> Stars are how small projects survive. If this one earned yours, tap ⭐ — it costs nothing and helps someone else find it.

plugins.description: The deterministic trust chain for DeepSeek Harness: eight plugins + dsh-bench-local — zero LLM in the trust path. Now expanding to OpenCode (oc-read-guard)
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-trust-suite — the deterministic trust chain for DeepSeek Harness

One thesis, three plugins, zero LLM calls in the trust path:

> The dsh plugin ecosystem reviews agents with LLMs — answer reviewers,
> advisor loops, goal verifiers. Everything that *must not be an LLM* —
> the parts a probabilistic reviewer can be injected past — is what this
> family owns.

| Plugin | Guards | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| [dsh-read-guard](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-read-guard) | what the agent **reads** | Prompt-injection interception in the `tools/post-execute` waterfall: file reads, repo searches, and web fetches are scanned before they enter model context — quarantined, blocked, or passed. Engine: [repo-inject-guard](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/repo-inject-guard) |
| [dsh-pr-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-pr-gate) | what the agent **writes** | Deterministic write gate: scope policy denies out-of-scope writes before they touch the disk, residue rules scan the written text, a content-hashed JSONL ledger records every decision. The CI gate moved to the moment of the write. Engine: [agent-pr-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-pr-gate) |
| [dsh-attest-chain](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-attest-chain) | what the agent **did** | Signed chain-of-custody: every watched tool result appends a hash-chained, ed25519-signed record. Tamper with a line, break the chain; delete the tail, break the published head. Engine: [agent-attest](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-attest) |
| [dsh-mcp-test](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-mcp-test) | what the agent **can call** | Tool-surface snapshot and drift gate: the full visible registry (first-party, plugin, MCP tools) is baselined and diffed — upgrades that silently change the model-visible surface fail loud. Methodology: [mcp-test](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/mcp-test) |
| [dsh-janitor](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-janitor) | what the agent **leaves behind** | Deterministic cleanup plans for session debris (plan docs, scratch scripts): scan → verdicts with evidence → review. The janitor is never an agent; v0.1 never deletes. Engine: [agent-janitor](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/agent-janitor) |
| [dsh-egress-gate](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-egress-gate) | **where data may flow** | Destination allowlist for web fetches/searches, denied in `tools/pre-execute` before they run; shell fetch-verbs observed (enforcement opt-in). The other half of exfil defense: content scanning guards what enters, this guards where it leaves. |
| [dsh-prompt-drift](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-prompt-drift) | what the model is **told** | System-prompt surface drift gate: every section contributed by any plugin/preset is hashed and baselined; a silent rewrite of the prompt fails loud. |
| [dsh-freeze](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-freeze) | what exactly is **running** | Hermetic composition lock: the profile's dependencies, bundle order, lockfile hash, and patch layer are fingerprinted; booting a drifted composition warns — or fails under `strict` (the `--frozen` posture for CI). |

Read + write + do + call + leave-behind + egress + told + running: the eight
channels through which an agent session can go wrong, each gated by a
deterministic rule engine with its own upstream test suite, Windows+Linux
CI, and an honest kill-criteria section.

## Install the family

```sh
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-read-guard
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-pr-gate
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-attest-chain
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-mcp-test
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-janitor
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-egress-gate
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-prompt-drift
dsh plugin --profile default add dsh-freeze
```

All ship prebuilt `lib/` — git installs need no build step and no
`allowBuilds` authorization. Each ships its own config in `cordis.patch.yml`
and composes without interference (different pipeline stages).

## Second runtime: OpenCode

The family is expanding beyond dsh — [oc-read-guard](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/oc-read-guard) ports the read-channel guard to [OpenCode](https://opencode.ai) (tool.execute.after, live-verified quarantine in real sessions: the model reports the injection indicators and refuses to comply). One engine, every harness.

## Why a family, and against whom

The dsh security lane (checked 2026-10-12) is a long tail without a winner:
~15 injection-defense plugins, none above 85★, the strongest being a
model-callable scanner (the model can decline to call it) and one
three-point interceptor with literal pattern lists. Nothing on the write
side, nothing on custody. The family's edge is not being first — it is that
every rule engine here is vendored from a battle-tested upstream repository
with its own CI, competitive analysis, and kill criteria, instead of being a
weekend pattern list. Few plugins, deep engines, upstream ownership — the
deliberate opposite of the 90-plugin land-grab strategy visible in the
ecosystem today.

## Roadmap (next in the family)

- **dsh-bench** has shipped as its own repo —
  [zhengqiuyang/dsh-bench](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/dsh-bench-local): bench
  your dsh configuration against your own tasks via `dsh headless`
  (live-verified). Its mining pillar (tasks from git history, graded by your
  own tests) ports agentbench-local next.
- **skills lockfile** — hermetic pinning for skills/plugins à la
  [vendor-skills](https://github.com/zhengqiuyang/vendor-skills); today's
  supply-chain plugins all static-scan, none reproducibly pin.
- **mcp-test probe pillar** — behavioral + injection probes against running
  MCP servers (the headline feature of upstream mcp-test) on top of
  dsh-mcp-test's drift gate.

## Kill criteria

Per-plugin kill criteria live in each README. Family-level: if dsh ships a
first-party deterministic trust layer covering read/write/custody, the family
freezes and this README records the postmortem. The engines live on in their
upstream repositories regardless.

plugins.description: Bring DSH back to the foreground when a real-device control turn ends (Android / Shizuku).
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-return-front

**真机控制任务结束后，自动把 DSH 切回前台。**

> 适用：**Android 上的 DSH**（Termux 系运行时 + Shizuku 特权通道）。
> 其他平台装上无害——插件会正常加载，但不会做任何事。

---

## 它解决什么问题

在 Android 上用 DSH 驱动真机（点按、开 App、滑动）时，**被操作的那个 App 会占据前台**，DSH 退到后台。于是每跑完一个任务，你都要手动切回 DSH 才能看结果、发下一句。

装上这个插件后：

| | 之前 | 之后 |
|---|---|---|
| 让 agent 在真机上点开某 App | 任务结束，**你手动切回 DSH** | 任务结束，**DSH 自己回到前台** |
| 纯只读任务（截图 / dump） | 前台没变 | **不触发**（本来就没变） |
| 虚拟屏任务 | 不影响真机前台 | **不触发** |

触发条件被刻意收窄，只在"本回合**真的动过真机前台**"且"你开着开关"时才动作。

## 前提条件

1. **DSH 跑在 Android 上**（Termux 系运行时，这决定了宿主 App 的包名可被自动探测）
2. **Shizuku 特权通道就绪**（插件通过它执行拉起命令）
3. **屏幕范围含真机**：`scope` 为 `all` 或 `real-only`
   - 出厂默认是 `virtual-only`。该模式下 agent 本来就动不了真机前台，**所以插件什么都不做**（这是对的，不是 bug）
4. 能执行特权 shell 的运行档位（如 `danger-full-access`）

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zxyan99/dsh-return-front
```

装完**重启 DSH**，然后刷新页面。

手工安装（等价，适合本地源码）：

1. 把本仓库放到任意目录
2. 在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/` 下建一个指向它的软链：
   ```sh
   ln -s /path/to/dsh-return-front "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-return-front"
   ```
3. 在 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 末尾追加：
   ```yaml
   - insert:
       - id: dsh-return-front
         name: dsh-return-front
   ```
4. 重启 DSH

> 装配顺序需**晚于** `@dsh-android/dsh-android-bridge`（因为要用它提供的特权服务）。放在 patch 末尾通常就满足。

## 使用

**设置 → 通用**，会看到一行：

> **任务收尾**
> ☑ 真机控制任务结束后回到 DSH

勾选/取消即时生效并持久化（存在 `$DSH_HOME/dsh-return-front.json`）。默认开启。

## 工作原理（简述）

- 订阅 `session/event`，在 `turn/start` 清空状态、在 `tool/call` 记录"本回合是否动过真机前台"、在 `turn/end` 决定是否动作
- **计入**的工具：`android_app_launch`、`android_ui_click`、`android_act_input`、`android_ui_scroll`、`android_ui_input`、`android_ui_global`
- **排除**：全部 `android_vdisplay_*`；全部只读类（`device_info`/`screen_list`/`ui_dump`/`ui_detail`/`ui_tree`/`screenshot`/`web_dump`）
- `screenId` 缺省或 `real` 才算真机；`virtual-N` 不计
- 动作就是一条拉起命令：`monkey -p <宿主包名> -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1`
- 开关通过一条带鉴权的回环路由读写（`/api/dsh-return-front`）

**宿主包名是自动探测的**，取自 Termux 标准环境变量 `TERMUX_APP__DATA_DIR` 的目录名，因此不绑定某个特定的壳应用构建。

## 配置（可选）

在 profile 的 patch 里：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-return-front
      name: dsh-return-front
      config:
        enabled: true           # 初始开关状态（之后以设置页/状态文件为准）
        appPackage: com.example.shell   # 手动指定宿主 App 包名（一般不需要）
        launchCommand: "monkey -p com.example.shell -c android.intent.category.LAUNCHER 1"
```

环境变量覆盖：`DSH_RETURN_FRONT_APP_PACKAGE`。

## 已知边界（诚实清单）

- **只在 Android 上有意义。** 非 Android 宿主上插件会加载但永不动作。
- **`scope=virtual-only` 时不工作**，且这是设计意图：该模式下 agent 动不了真机前台，切回没有意义。插件会静默跳过并写一行 debug 日志，不报错、不刷屏。
- **Shizuku 未运行 / 档位不足**时不报错，只吞掉失败（一行 debug 日志）。
- **只做"切回前台"这一件事**：不改前台内容、不清理、不重启引擎、不碰用户数据。
- 若本回合**动过真机但用户已主动切到别处**，回合结束时仍会被拉回 DSH——这是开关语义的一部分；不想要就关掉。

## 开发

无需构建链，纯手写 bundle（客户端用 `React.createElement` 避开 JSX）。

```sh
node tests/smoke.mjs
```

密闭测试（不接触设备）：覆盖宿主包名自动探测、路由鉴权、持久化、以及触发矩阵（只读不触发 / 真机触发 / 虚拟屏不触发 / 关开关不触发 / 重复 `turn/end` 只触发一次 / 特权通道抛错被吞）。

## 许可

MIT © zxyan99

# 🎮 dsh-mini-games-lee — DeepSeek Harness 小游戏合集

在 **DeepSeek Harness Web GUI** 上运行的小游戏合集：一个毛玻璃悬浮窗，内含 **4 个游戏**，可随时切换、拖动、收起。

| 游戏 | 玩法 | 排行榜 |
|---|---|---|
| 🕹️ **俄罗斯方块** | 7-bag 出块、墙踢旋转、消行计分、逐级加速、下一块预览 | 分数（高→低） |
| 🐍 **贪吃蛇** | 15×15 网格，吃食物变长、撞墙/自撞结束、每 3 个加速一级 | 分数（高→低） |
| 🔢 **2048** | 4×4 合并到 2048，键盘或屏幕方向键 | 分数（高→低） |
| 💣 **扫雷** | 初级 9×9/10 雷、中级 12×12/24 雷，左键翻开 / 右键标记，首点安全 | 用时（低→高） |

共性：
- ☀️/🌙 深浅色主题一键切换，毛玻璃背景
- 窗口可拖到页面任意位置，`▁`/`✕` 收起为标题条（自动暂停），`□` 还原
- **每个游戏独立排行榜**（最近 10 局，localStorage 持久化、可清空）
- 键盘全局操作（打开期间无需点击窗口），同时提供屏幕按钮，输入框打字不受影响

## ✅ 运行环境（DSH 版本标识）

| 组件 | 版本 |
|---|---|
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh`（Harness CLI / Web GUI） | **`0.2.0-rc.2`**（已实测） |
| 插件形态 | **profile bundle**（`dsh.bundle.patch` + `dsh.client`），经 `plugin_manager` 安装 |
| 客户端硬依赖 | `slots`（两个槽位）、`timer`（各游戏时钟） |
| 占用槽位 | `conversation.session.header.utilities`（右上角）、`shell.overlay`（悬浮层） |

## 🚀 安装

### 推荐：作为 bundle 安装（重启后仍在）

用 **git 规格**装（得到真实目录副本）：

```
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "github:LeeGuanWei-a/dsh-mini-games-lee" })
```

或等价的 CLI：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:LeeGuanWei-a/dsh-mini-games-lee
```

> ❗ **不要用本地路径装**（`target: "F:\\Projects\\dsh-mini-games-lee"`）。那会产出 `link:` 依赖，profile 里的目录是个 junction；Node 会把它解析到真实位置，而本包的裸包名行**在真实位置之上解析不到**，Loader 拿不到 fiber，`install_bundle` 报 `failed to import`。git / registry 规格才是受支持的安装方式（`@deepseek-ai` 自带的 bundle 也是这么装的）。

安装后 profile 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 会登记本包，`cordis.patch.yml` 插入的那一行由 Loader 挂载，浏览器半区通过包清单里的 `dsh.client` 被发现。返回 `application: applied` 且 `warnings` 为空即表示已生效；会话标题栏**右上角**出现 🎮，页面中央出现游戏窗口。

> 📍 **🎮 的位置**：在 `conversation.session.header.utilities`（会话标题栏右对齐工具条，即页面右上角），`order: 20` 排在自带条目之后、贴着右边缘。
> 这一槽是 **Session 作用域**：空白 Hero 页没有标题栏，也就没有 🎮；但游戏窗口本身在 root 作用域的 `shell.overlay` 里，已经打开的窗口不受影响。
> 没有选隔壁的 `conversation.session.header.corner`：那是 `single` 且 `replaceRisk: shadows-shipped-ui`，并且已被自带控件占用，注册进去会**顶掉**那个控件。

### 备用：`cordis_define` 动态插件

`dist/cordis-plugin.code.txt` 里按 `<<<HOST>>>` / `<<<CLIENT>>>` 分好了两半，可直接粘进 `cordis_define` 工具的 `code.host` / `code.client`。这条路不写入 profile，刷新页面即失效，适合临时试用或无法安装 bundle 的 profile。

首次加载会弹 client approval；批准后窗口出现。

## 🧱 两个半区怎么合起来

DSH 的 bundle 是**一个包、两个半区**，两者互不 import：

```
profile 的 dsh.profile.bundles
        │
        ├─ cordis.patch.yml ──► insert 一行
        │                         id:   dsh-mini-games-lee
        │                         name: dsh-mini-games-lee   ← 裸包名，必须是裸包名
        │
        └─ package.json 的 dsh.client
                 platform: "web"                  ← 声明这是 web 客户端插件
                 immediately: true                ← 开机即激活，不等 Session
                 inject: [ui-sidebar, ui-layout]  ← 只影响激活顺序
                 │
                 └─ exports["./client"] ──► dist/client.js  ← 浏览器半区
```

Host 半区 `dist/index.js` 只导出空的 `apply()`：它唯一的职责是让这一行在 Loader 里激活。浏览器半区 `dist/client.js` 才是全部逻辑，以 Client 模块表的 `window.__ModuleLoader__.load({ id, factory })` 形式注册，`React` 由模块表的 `require('react')` 提供。

> ⚠️ **`name` 必须是裸包名 `dsh-mini-games-lee`，不能用相对路径** —— 两件事都靠它：
>
> **① 解析。** bundle patch 插入的行以**bundle 自己的目录**为解析基准（`dsh-plugin-manager`：`base = active?.baseUrl ?? pathToFileURL(join(dir, "package.json")).href`），不是 profile。从 `node_modules/dsh-mini-games-lee/` 向上一级就能命中包名。**唯一会失败的情况是 `link:` / 本地路径安装**：那种情况下目录是个 junction，Node 会把它解析到真实位置，而真实位置之上没有任何 `node_modules`。所以要用 **git / registry 规格**安装（得到真实目录副本，`@deepseek-ai` 自带 bundle 也是这么装的），不要用本地路径。
>
> **② 显示元数据。** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` 的 `readPluginMeta` 第一行就是 `if (barePackageName(specifier) === void 0) return void 0`。行名写成路径 → **元数据整块放弃**：Plugin Manager 退回把解析后的模块 URL 当作组件名打印，本包的 `icon.svg` 和 `locale/*.json` 里的标题/描述**一个都不会被读**。裸包名是这一切的前置条件。

## 🎮 操作

窗口顶部是一排 **游戏标签**，点击切换（切换会开始新的一局）。

### 🕹️ 俄罗斯方块

| 操作 | 按键 / 屏幕按钮 |
|---|---|
| 左右移动 | `←` / `→`，或 ← → |
| 软降（+1/格） | `↓`，或 ▼ |
| 旋转（带墙踢） | `↑` 或 `X`，或 ↻ |
| 反向旋转 | `Z` |
| 硬降（+2/格） | `空格`，或 ⤓ |
| 暂停 / 继续 | `P`，或 Ⅱ |

### 🐍 贪吃蛇

| 操作 | 按键 / 屏幕按钮 |
|---|---|
| 转向（反向输入被忽略） | `←` `→` `↑` `↓` 或 `WASD`，或 ↑ ← ↓ → |
| 暂停 / 继续 | `空格` 或 `P`，或 Ⅱ |

### 🔢 2048

| 操作 | 按键 / 屏幕按钮 |
|---|---|
| 滑动合并 | `←` `→` `↑` `↓` 或 `WASD`，或 ↑ ← ↓ → |
| 暂停 / 继续 | `P`，或 Ⅱ |

### 💣 扫雷

| 操作 | 按键 / 屏幕按钮 |
|---|---|
| 翻开格子（首次点击才布雷，该格及周围保证无雷） | 鼠标左键 |
| 插旗 / 取消插旗 | 鼠标右键 |
| 切换难度（初级 9×9 · 中级 12×12） | 初级 / 中级 |
| 重新开始 | ↺ 新局 |

## 📦 仓库结构

```
dsh-mini-games-lee/
├── package.json            # bundle 清单：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client + exports
├── cordis.patch.yml        # 插入 Host 行（name: dsh-mini-games-lee，裸包名）
├── icon.svg                # Plugin Manager 卡片图标（package.json 的 icon 字段）
├── locale/
│   ├── en.json             # 卡片显示元数据：meta.title / meta.description
│   └── zh.json             #   语言文件必须叫语言 id（本宿主内置的只有 zh / en）
├── src/
│   ├── index.js            # Host 半区：空 apply（纯 UI 插件）
│   ├── client.js           # 浏览器半区入口：游戏注册表 + apply
│   ├── shared/
│   │   ├── theme.js        # 深浅色板
│   │   ├── records.js      # 按游戏分库的 localStorage 排行榜
│   │   ├── store.js        # 窗口状态（open/theme/pos/game）
│   │   └── ui.js           # 悬浮窗框架：拖拽、游戏标签、通用排行榜、入口按钮
│   └── games/
│       ├── tetris.js       # 🕹️ 俄罗斯方块
│       ├── snake.js        # 🐍 贪吃蛇
│       ├── g2048.js        # 🔢 2048
│       └── minesweeper.js  # 💣 扫雷
├── dist/                   # 构建产物（`npm run build` 生成）
│   ├── index.js            #   Host 半区 —— Loader 挂载的就是它
│   ├── client.js           #   浏览器半区 —— exports["./client"]
│   ├── cordis-plugin.js    #   两半区合并成 `{ host, client }`，供工具/归档消费
│   └── cordis-plugin.code.txt  # 两半区分段文本，供 cordis_define 粘贴
└── scripts/
    ├── inline.mjs          # 【关键】模块顺序 + import/export 剥离，唯一的平铺作用域权威
    ├── build-cordis.mjs    # 唯一的构建脚本：平铺体 → 上面 4 个产物
    ├── smoke.mjs           # 按模块表方式加载 dist/client.js，断言两槽位注册正确
    ├── smoke-cordis.mjs    # 断言 code.txt 两半区完整、可求值，且与 dist 产物同源
    ├── render-check.mjs    # 真实 React 渲染每个组件（深浅两色）
    ├── dev-cordis.mjs      # 本地替身外壳，肉眼确认 4 个游戏可玩
    └── build-lib.mjs       # 归档（旧的 src → lib 内联打包）
```

### 加一个新游戏

1. 在 `src/games/` 新建模块，导出一个游戏对象：

   ```js
   export const MYGAME = (() => {
     function View(props) {           // props: { timer, th, active, onGameOver, onOpenRank }
       // 用 el(...) 渲染；props.th 提供当前主题色；
       // props.active 为 false 时不要跑时钟/键盘；
       // 需要时钟就用 props.timer.interval(fn, ms)，并在 effect 里返回它的 disposer；
       // 一局结束时调用一次 onGameOver({ value: 分数, meta: '说明文字' })
     }
     return { id: 'mygame', title: '我的游戏', icon: '🎯', short: '短名', scoreOrder: 'desc', View }
   })()
   ```

2. 在 `src/client.js` 的 `GAMES` 数组里加入它；
3. 在 `scripts/inline.mjs` 的 `MODULES` 里把新文件加在 `src/client.js` **之前**（顺序 = 扁平作用域里的依赖顺序）；
4. `npm run check` 校验，然后 `npm run build` 重新生成 `dist/`；
5. 重新装一次（git 规格），让 Loader 拿到新的模块代与 patch。

## 🏆 排行榜说明

- 每个游戏独立存储：`dsh.minigames.records.v1.<gameId>`；
- 每局结束自动记录（扫雷只记胜利局），保留最近 10 条；
- 排序：多数游戏按分数降序，扫雷按用时升序；
- 数据保存在**本机浏览器** localStorage，清站点数据 / 无痕 / 换浏览器会丢；
- 排行榜视图内可两次点击清空当前游戏的记录。

## 🛠️ 本地校验（无需宿主）

```sh
npm install
npm run check       # build + smoke:cordis + smoke + render-check
```

- `npm run build` —— 把 `scripts/inline.mjs` 列出的 9 个模块按依赖顺序拼成**单一扁平作用域**，再包成 Host 半区、模块表浏览器半区、合并载荷、`cordis_define` 文本四份产物
- `npm run smoke` —— 按模块表方式加载 `dist/client.js`，断言两个槽位以正确的 id 注册、`apply` 交回 disposer、缺 `timer` 服务时保持惰性
- `npm run smoke:cordis` —— 断言 `code.txt` 两半区分隔完整，客户端半区可按动态 runner 的方式求值，并确认各产物出自同一个平铺体
- `npm run render-check` —— 用 real React + `react-dom/server` **真实渲染**每个注册的组件（深浅两色），抓"能注册但一渲染就崩"的故障（例如 `el is not defined`）
- `npm run dev:cordis` —— 起一个本地替身外壳（默认 http://127.0.0.1:5188/ ），用本包自带的 React UMD 跑 `dist/client.js`，肉眼确认 4 个游戏都可玩

> ⚠️ **不要把这些源码交给 esbuild 之类的 ESM 打包器**。`src/` 是"扁平共享作用域"写法：模块之间互相引用 `el`、`useStore`、`THEMES` 等声明而**不写 import**，模块顺序由 `scripts/inline.mjs` 的 `MODULES` 决定。真 ESM 打包会给每个模块单独作用域，于是 `useStore is not defined`；而且 esbuild 会把 `el` 改名成 `el2` 却漏改其它模块里的 `el(...)` 调用点，于是 `el is not defined`。两个故障都实测出现过。新增/移动模块时改 `MODULES` 顺序即可。

## 🔄 回滚

```
plugin_manager({ action: "remove_bundle", target: "dsh-mini-games-lee" })
```

用 `cordis_define` 装的则执行 `cordis_undefine({ pluginId: "minig.<id>" })`。

## 📄 许可证

MIT。

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-model-usage

适用于 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的**供应商模型账户用量查询插件**。

它在会话页面头部放一个「用量」入口，点开即可看到**当前对话所用模型**对应供应商账户的用量
——余额、套餐窗口、已用额度、信用余额；也可以手动切到任意可路由的模型，去查别的供应商的额度，
不必再逐个打开各家控制台。

- 插件包本体：[`model-usage/`](model-usage/)（包名 `dsh-model-usage`）
- 功能细节（原理、凭据解析、各家用量接口、刷新策略、面板内容、安装步骤）：
  [model-usage/README.md](model-usage/README.md)
- 许可证：[MIT](LICENSE)

## 仓库结构

| 路径 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| [`model-usage/`](model-usage/) | 插件包本体：node 半负责用量查询与 loopback Web 路由，浏览器半负责会话头部入口与弹窗面板 |
| [`model-usage/README.md`](model-usage/README.md) | 插件层功能说明，是使用与二次开发的主要文档 |
| [`LICENSE`](LICENSE) | MIT License |

## 快速开始

安装与挂载步骤见[插件说明](model-usage/README.md#安装)，概括为三步：

1. 把 `model-usage/` 作为插件包装进 DSH profile（`dsh plugin add <插件目录绝对路径>`，
   或直接复制 / 建 junction 到 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/dsh-model-usage`）；
2. 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 `insert` 里挂载入口 `dsh-model-usage`；
3. 重启 `dsh web`（host 半生效），浏览器硬刷新（浏览器半生效）。

## 参与贡献

**这个项目友善地欢迎开源合作，也欢迎任何人提交 PR。**
无论是新增一家供应商的用量适配器、修掉一个边界情况、改进文案与文档，还是指出我们写错的字段名，
都同样有价值；哪怕只是把某家接口的真实返回贴给我们做校准，也是实打实的帮助。

- **新供应商适配**：在 `model-usage/lib/index.js` 里认领一个 query kind（`kindOf()` 按 host / provider 判定）、
  写一个归一化函数（`{ rows }` / `{ windows, models }`），客户端会自动用通用卡片渲染；
  已支持的路由与接口形态见[用量接口](model-usage/README.md#用量接口)。
- **未文档化的接口**：如果某家用量接口没有公开文档，欢迎在 PR 描述里附上脱敏后的真实返回，
  我们会据此收敛字段名，而不是靠猜。
- **提交方式**：fork 本仓库 → 建一个语义清晰的分支 → 提交 PR，并在描述里写清「解决什么、怎么验证、影响哪些路由」。
  状态类改动请附上截图或最小复现步骤。
- **协作方式**：我们会对每个 PR 认真 review、尽量及时回复；分歧时优先讨论方案而不是互相消耗。
  提交即表示同意你的贡献以本仓库的 [MIT 许可](LICENSE)发布。
- 还不确定怎么改也没关系，先开 issue 描述你看到的场景与期望行为，我们一起来定方案。

## 许可证与生态

本项目以 [MIT License](LICENSE) 发布。

- 上游 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 同样以 **MIT** 许可发布，
  与本仓库一致，因此代码可以在两个方向自由复用；若将来某个适配器被官方收录，也不存在许可障碍。
- 本项目是**独立的社区插件**，与深度求索公司无隶属、合作或背书关系；
  "DeepSeek Harness" 是深度求索公司的注册商标，本仓库仅在描述性文字中说明兼容关系。
  命名遵循官方[品牌素材使用规范](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/BRAND_GUIDELINES.zh.md)，
  使用 `DSH` 缩写而非完整商标。
- 如果你是插件作者，可以在自己的仓库上添加 `dsh-plugin` 话题，方便社区检索（官方推荐做法）。

<!-- MIRROR-NOTE:START -->
> [!NOTE]
> 📦 This plugin lives in the [**dsh-plugins**](https://github.com/hy-sde/dsh-plugins) monorepo — file issues & pull requests there.
> npm: [`@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork)
<!-- MIRROR-NOTE:END -->

# dsh-tool-tsfork — Go-native TypeScript compiler devices for DeepSeek Harness

A standalone package, installable as **one plugin** (two device tools) for the
DeepSeek Harness: model-facing devices over a **parked Go-native TypeScript
compiler** — the [can1357/TypeScript](https://github.com/can1357/TypeScript)
perf fork (`perf/checker-speedups-v3`, TS `7.1.0-dev`). `tsfork_status`
reports the binary, version banner and build stamp; `tsfork_check` runs
one-shot `-b` project-graph checks with parsed diagnostics, wall time, and a
GOMAXPROCS cap. The compiler binary is built once and parked on the host; the
plugin only speaks the harness device seam — zero upstream harness changes.

| Identity | Value |
| --- | --- |
| Package | `@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork` |
| Plugin id | `hy-sde-tsfork` |
| Devices | `tsfork_status` · `tsfork_check` (device-catalog tools via `dyn`) |

> **Based on [can1357/TypeScript](https://github.com/can1357/TypeScript)**
> (`perf/checker-speedups-v3`, a Go rewrite of
> [microsoft/TypeScript](https://github.com/microsoft/TypeScript), Apache-2.0
> lineage): no compiler code is ported or modified — this package is original
> plugin code that spawns the binary once per call over a stable CLI contract
> (`tsc -b`, JSON-free default output). Adapted, not ported: the harness
> device seam (`device: true` tools via `ctx.tools` + `ctx.systemPrompt`)
> exists so a deployment can expose a fast compiler without touching the
> repo's pinned toolchain. See
> [THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md](THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.md).

## Why

The type gate on a large workspace is the stock `tsc -b` over the whole
solution graph — on the fork harness's 337-project host graph that was
**54.25s cold** (91.6s CPU, 4.6GB peak), and every agent that wants a
typecheck pays it serially. The Go compiler checks the same graph
byte-identically (project listings, 14/14 planted errors, deterministic
output) in **7.05s cold / ~0.6s warm** — 7.7× less wall time, 3.4× less CPU.
But nothing in a harness exposes it: gates run through `pnpm` scripts pinned
to `typescript@6.0.3`, and a plugin cannot replace a repo's own toolchain —
nor should it, because oxlint `typeAware` and the typert generator need the
JS API that TS 7 (a Go binary) does not ship. What agents need is a *device*
pointing at a parked binary: loadable per deployment, unloadable by toggling
one row, structured output, no PATH tricks, no upstream changes — while the
pinned toolchain stays exactly as pinned.

## Prerequisites

- Node.js **22.19 or newer** (the package's `engines` floor) with pnpm on `PATH`;
- a DeepSeek Harness installation with the device catalog (the package's peer
  baseline is `@deepseek-ai/cordis ~4.0.5-alpha.1`,
  `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt`
  `^0.2.1-alpha.2`; registries without the device concept simply present the
  tools eagerly);
- a tsfork compiler binary parked on the host (default `~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc`)
  with a `VERSION` stamp beside it — build it once from a checkout of the
  fork:

  ```bash
  git clone https://github.com/can1357/TypeScript.ts.git typescript.ts   # or your fork
  cd typescript.ts && git checkout perf/checker-speedups-v3
  go build -o ~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc ./cmd/tsc        # inside the tsc/ dir of the checkout
  printf 'source: can1357/TypeScript perf/checker-speedups-v3 @ <commit>\n' > ~/.dsh/tsfork/VERSION
  ```

  (the Go tree ships its generated files — no generate step; Go 1.27+)

## Quick start

### Route A — published npm package (recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork
```

> Publishing after the Shape-A trial — until then use Route B.

### Route B — from source (validate this checkout or hack on the plugin)

```bash
git clone git@github.com:hy-sde/dsh-plugins.git
cd dsh-plugins/dsh-tool-tsfork/packages/tool-tsfork
pnpm install
PACKAGE_TARBALL="$(pnpm pack | tail -n 1)"
dsh plugin --profile web add "$PWD/$PACKAGE_TARBALL"
cd ../../../..
```

Deployment variant used for the trial (no `dsh` CLI on PATH, hand-managed
profile): link the built package into the profile with an absolute `file:`
path — `pnpm add file:<abs-path-to-package>` in the profile dir, then add
`@hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork` to `dsh.profile.bundles`. The package's own
`dsh.bundle.patch` mounts the `hy-sde-tsfork` row.

### Verify the composed configuration

```bash
dsh web --dump-config
```

### Run

Start the harness (`dsh web`) and ask the agent to check or probe a graph.
The model-facing calls (device catalog — `dyn search tsfork`):

- `tsfork_status` (no arguments) — resolved binary, `Version 7.1.0-dev`
  banner, build stamp from `<binaryDir>/VERSION`, 20s health probe.
- `tsfork_check` — `tsc -b <project>`; returns `exitCode`, `wallMs`,
  `errorCount`/`warningCount`, parsed `diagnostics` (`file:line:col TSxxxx`),
  an `outputTail`, and a reproducible `command`. `dry: true` prepends
  `--dry` (list the projects a build would run, without building). Pass
  `cwd` (and `project`) explicitly outside the deployment's default checkout.

### Uninstall

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove @hy-sde-org/dsh-tool-tsfork
```

## What the bundle does

The plugin's `cordis.patch.yml` mounts **one plain agent-plane row**
(`hy-sde-tsfork`) that consumes the deployment's host services — `tools` and
`systemPrompt` (the stock agent bundle provides both). No service, realm, or
filesystem seam of its own: each call spawns the parked compiler once, so
concurrent agent lanes are isolated by construction and the only shared-box
knob is GOMAXPROCS. It also registers the `tsfork:tools` prompt section,
which documents the buildinfo gotcha and the adoption boundary to every
session that mounts the device.

## Engine behavior

- **One-shot spawn, stdin closed.** Every call is `spawn(binary, argv)` with
  `stdio: ['ignore', 'pipe', 'pipe']` — the compiler never reads stdin, and
  a held-open pipe is the classic CLI-wrapper hang.
- **Flag order.** The Go parser requires `-b`/`--build` to precede the
  project path; post-project flags (`--dry`, …) are accepted after it. A
  bare `tsc <tsconfig>` (no `-b`) fails with TS5112 — the plugin always
  sends `-b` first.
- **Timeout semantics.** SIGTERM at `timeoutMs`, SIGKILL 5s later — the
  escalation is scheduled *by* the timeout, never at spawn. A timed-out run
  resolves with `timedOut: true` and the partial output instead of rejecting.
- **Output caps.** stdout/stderr are captured up to `maxOutputBytes` per
  side (default 4 MiB, flagged `outputTruncated`); diagnostics are capped at
  500 with exact counts kept beyond the cap (`diagnosticsTruncated`).
- **`.tsbuildinfo` is compiler-version-tagged.** Alternating `tsfork_check`
  with the repo's stock `tsc -b` invalidates the other side's incremental
  caches — runs go cold. The prompt section warns agents; pick a primary
  and accept the other side paying one cold run.
- **Adoption boundary.** tsfork does not replace the pinned `typescript@6.0.3`
  toolchain: oxlint `typeAware` and typert need the JS API (TS 7's npm
  package is a launcher shim with no `lib/typescript.js`). Promotion, if the
  trial proves out, is a `pnpm` override of the gate binary — not this
  plugin.

## Configuration

| Option | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `binary` | `~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc` | Compiler binary (expandable `~`), must be executable |
| `defaultProject` | — | `-b` project used when a call omits `project` |
| `defaultCwd` | — | Working directory used when a call omits `cwd` |
| `timeoutMs` | `900000` | Per-call process timeout |
| `gomaxprocs` | — | `GOMAXPROCS` written to the child env (lane-friendly parallelism cap) |
| `maxOutputBytes` | `4000000` | Cap on captured stdout/stderr bytes per side |

```yaml
- id: hy-sde-tsfork
  config:
    binary: ~/.dsh/tsfork/tsc
    defaultProject: tsconfig.host.json
    defaultCwd: /path/to/your/checkout
    timeoutMs: 900000
    gomax

plugins.readme_text:
# agent-stash

[![CI](https://github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Sync init prompts](https://github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash/actions/workflows/sync-init-prompts.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash/actions/workflows/sync-init-prompts.yml)
[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/Alice39s/agent-stash)](LICENSE)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/Alice39s/agent-stash)](https://github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash/commits/main)
[![pi package](https://img.shields.io/badge/pi-package-111111)](https://pi.dev)
[![DSH plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/DeepSeek%20Harness-plugin-4d6bfe)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
[![Node.js](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D24-339933?logo=nodedotjs&logoColor=white)](https://nodejs.org)
[![pnpm](https://img.shields.io/badge/pnpm-11-f69220?logo=pnpm&logoColor=white)](https://pnpm.io)
[![TypeScript](https://img.shields.io/badge/TypeScript-strict-3178c6?logo=typescript&logoColor=white)](tsconfig.json)

自用的 Agent Skills、[pi](https://pi.dev) 扩展与 [DSH（DeepSeek Harness）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)插件合集。

## 目录

| 路径                   | 内容                                                                              |
| ---------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `src/`                 | pi 与 DSH 共用的实现                                                              |
| `pi/extensions/`       | pi 扩展，由 `package.json` 的 `pi.extensions` 声明                                |
| `dsh/`                 | DSH 插件源码、`cordis.patch.yml`、本地化文案与图标                                |
| `dist/`                | DSH 插件的构建产物，由 `pnpm build` 生成，随仓库提交                              |
| `vendor/init-prompts/` | 从上游仓库同步的 `/init` prompt、许可证与 `manifest.json`，由脚本生成，不手动修改 |
| `scripts/`             | 同步脚本                                                                          |

## 安装

### pi

```bash
pi install git:github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash
```

只在当前会话试用：

```bash
pi -e git:github.com/Alice39s/agent-stash
```

### DSH

DeepSeek Harness 桌面版：在「插件」页点「添加插件」，填入 `github:Alice39s/agent-stash` 后安装。

命令行：把仓库作为 bundle 装进某个 profile，例如 Web 界面使用的 `web`：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Alice39s/agent-stash
```

`dist/` 已随仓库提交，安装时不需要构建。DSH 的斜杠命令目前只在 Web 界面与桌面版里可用。

## `/init`

让 agent 分析当前项目并写出 `AGENTS.md`，prompt 取自其他 coding agent 的开源实现。pi 与 DSH 的用法相同。

```text
/init                         使用默认预设
/init kimi-code               使用 kimi-code 预设
/init opencode 重点写测试流程    使用 opencode 预设并附加额外指令
/init 用中文写                 第一个词不是预设名时，整段文字作为默认预设的额外指令
```

pi：

- 输入 `/init ` 后，补全菜单列出每个预设及其上游来源，默认预设标出 `(default)`。
- 选中预设后，菜单提示可以继续输入 `[extra prompt]`。

DSH：

- 命令菜单列出全部预设，默认预设标出 `(default)`。
- 输入框提示可用的预设名，例如 `[codex|kimi-code|opencode] [extra prompt]`。
- 预设列表在 DSH 加载插件时生成，修改配置后要重启 DSH 才会更新。

### 内置预设

| 预设            | 上游                                                            | 文件                                                              | 许可证     |
| --------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | ---------- |
| `codex`（默认） | [openai/codex](https://github.com/openai/codex)                 | `codex-rs/tui/assets/prompt_for_init_command.md`                  | Apache-2.0 |
| `kimi-code`     | [MoonshotAI/kimi-code](https://github.com/MoonshotAI/kimi-code) | `packages/agent-core-v2/src/features/sessionInit/profile/init.md` | MIT        |
| `opencode`      | [anomalyco/opencode](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode)     | `packages/core/src/plugin/command/initialize.txt`                 | MIT        |

每个预设对应的上游 commit 记录在 `vendor/init-prompts/manifest.json`。

### 额外指令与占位符

模板里的占位符在发送前替换：

- `${path}`：当前项目目录。DSH 里取会话的当前工作目录。
- `$ARGUMENTS`：额外指令。

模板没有 `$ARGUMENTS` 时，额外指令追加到 prompt 末尾的 `## Additional instructions from the user` 小节。

### 配置

配置文件按以下顺序读取，后读的覆盖先读的。

pi：

1. `~/.pi/agent/agent-stash/init.json`（设置了 `PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR` 时为 `$PI_CODING_AGENT_DIR/agent-stash/init.json`）
2. `<项目>/.pi/agent-stash/init.json`，仅在项目受信任时读取

DSH：

1. `$DSH_HOME/agent-stash/init.json`（未设置 `DSH_HOME` 时为 `~/.dsh/agent-stash/init.json`）

```json
{
  "defaultPreset": "team",
  "presets": {
    "team": {
      "file": "./team-init.md",
      "description": "团队的 AGENTS.md 模板"
    }
  }
}
```

- `defaultPreset`：不写预设名时使用的预设，默认为 `codex`。
- `presets`：自定义预设。`file` 是相对配置文件所在目录的路径，同名预设覆盖内置预设。`description` 显示在补全菜单里，不写时显示文件路径。

配置格式错误或默认预设不存在时，`/init` 直接报错。

## 上游同步

`.github/workflows/sync-init-prompts.yml` 每天运行一次，也可以手动触发。它拉取各上游默认分支最新 commit 中的 prompt 与根目录的 LICENSE、NOTICE 文件，运行检查后向 `chore/sync-init-prompts` 分支开 PR。

仓库需要在 Settings → Actions → General 中开启「Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests」，workflow 才能创建 PR。

本地同步：

```bash
GITHUB_TOKEN=<token> pnpm sync:init-prompts
```

上游列表在 `scripts/sync-init-prompts.ts` 的 `SOURCES` 中维护。

## 开发

```bash
pnpm install
pnpm check    # oxfmt --check、oxlint 类型检查与 vitest
pnpm build    # 用 tsdown 生成 dist/dsh/init.js
pnpm format
```

改动 `src/` 或 `dsh/` 后要运行 `pnpm build` 并提交 `dist/`。CI 会重新构建，`dist/` 与源码不一致时失败。

## 许可证

本仓库使用 [Apache License 2.0](LICENSE)。`vendor/init-prompts/` 下的文件沿用各自上游的许可证，许可证原文与上游 prompt 放在同一目录。

# CaSee 市场情报分析专家 · DSH 插件 *由 CaSee 凯见情报平台驱动 —— 把 500+ 可信信源变成一名可溯源的市场情报分析师*

**简体中文** | [English](README.en.md) *** ## 关于 CaSee —— AI 驱动的竞争情报平台 **CaSee（凯见）** 是 AI 驱动的**竞争情报与市场洞察平台** —— 「谋定而后动，见微知著，决胜千里」。 CaSee 提供**可信信源竞争情报**，帮助创业公司发现市场机会、帮助成熟企业扩大竞争优势。它解决企业竞争情报的核心痛点： - 情报采集碎片化 - 人工分析低效 - 市场洞察滞后 - 情报无法进入业务决策 面向中大型企业的市场、销售、产品与战略团队，CaSee 把市场数据与业务决策连接起来 —— 从**被动竞争监测**升级为**主动市场趋势预判**。 ### 平台能力 | 能力 | 说明 | | --- | --- | | **实时竞争感知** | 针对具体业务线监测竞品、市场与客户；全景式外部环境扫描；分级实时威胁预警 | | **量化竞争威胁分析** | SWOT、PESTEL、BCG 矩阵、VRIO 框架等系统化分析工具，评估行业盈利性、竞争格局与政策风险 | | **主动策略评估** | 自研神经-因果 AI 长链因果推理引擎，预测竞争策略效果 —— 开放世界推理长链因果，封闭世界推理量化执行结果 | | **可信情报采集** | 实时竞品追踪、市场趋势预测、碎片化情报融合、目标导向的定向情报感知 | | **专家竞争分析** | 定制化 CI 分析能力建设、自助式专业报告、行业专家知识库 | > **可信情报保障**：量化 T-Score 可信度评分、多源交叉验证、因果推理偏差检测与合规护栏，防止 AI 幻觉、过期数据与虚假引用。 > **试用 CaSee**： —— 注册并获取 API 密钥。 *** ## 🎯 这是什么 `dsh-plugin-market-intelligence` 是面向 **DeepSeek Harness（DSH）** 的市场情报分析专家插件（一个 `dsh.bundle` 包）。装入后，它向当前 profile 贡献三件东西，把 CaSee 情报能力直接变成模型可调用的原生能力： | 贡献 | 内容 | | --- | --- | | **6 个模型可调用工具** | `find_trusted_sources`、`search_intelligence`、`analyze_trend`、`aggregate_by_source`、`search_with_cvc`、`semantic_search` | | **专家人格段落** | 注册为 system prompt 的 `market-intelligence:expert` 段（order 5）：分析师角色、三条铁律、T-Score/ABCD 分级、检索方法与双格式输出契约 | | **内置技能** | `market-intelligence` 技能（`ctx.skills` 运行时注册）：核心流程、检索策略、市场工作流、报告模板与 **HTML 报告样式规范** | > **取数通道说明**：插件直连 CaSee **REST** 接口（`/v1/sources/search`、`/v1/searchx`、`/v1/semantic-search`）。它与 `causalai.me:8100` 的 MCP 端点是**两条独立通道**，互不依赖。 *** ## 🤖 为什么用它 把竞争情报做进 agent 通常意味着：自己接 HTTP、做字段映射、去重、统计、缓存、调度、安全审查，再自造一套报告样式 —— 每个信源、每个产品都要重来一遍。 `dsh-plugin-market-intelligence` 把这些变成**一次安装 + 一套契约**： | 维度 | 手工集成 | 用本插件 | | --- | --- | --- | | **首个可用分析** | 数天（后端 + 前端 + 胶水） | 一次 `dsh plugin add` | | **数据可信度** | 自行判断来源真伪 | 每条情报自带 T-Score + ABCD 分级，可溯源 | | **检索能力** | 自建搜索与过滤 | 类 Google 查询语法 + 两阶段可信检索 + CVC 语义检索 | | **报告交付** | 自己写模板与图表 | 内置 CaSee 深色看板规范（appbar/封面/目录/编号章节/ECharts/来源附录） | | **幻觉风险** | 全靠提示词自律 | 工具层 + 人格层双重「零编造」约束 | > **核心价值**：市场情报能力变成**可安装、可配置、可复现**的 Harness 能力，且报告规范与 CaSee 官方报告同款。 *** ## 🚀 快速开始 ### 前置条件 - **Node.js ≥ 22.19**（DSH 运行时要求） - **DeepSeek Harness `dsh` ≥ 0.1.0-rc.6**（`dsh --version` 可查） - **CaSee API 密钥** —— 到 免费注册后获取 ### 第 1 步 —— 安装 ```bash # A. npm（推荐，包名即身份） dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-market-intelligence # B. GitHub 仓库 dsh plugin --profile web add github:xcasee/dsh-plugin-market-intelligence # C. tarball（离线 / 评审分发） dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-plugin-market-intelligence-1.0.0.tgz ``` 重启 `dsh web`。 ### 第 2 步 —— 确认插件层已生效 ```bash dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A6 market-intelligence ``` 应能看到： ``` # == dsh-plugin-market-intelligence - id: market-intelligence name: dsh-plugin-market-intelligence config: apiBaseUrl: http://121.43.113.132:8000 ... ``` ### 第 3 步 —— 配置 API 密钥 密钥**只从环境变量读取，绝不写入配置文件**： ```bash export CASEE_API_KEY=<你的密钥> ``` 然后**新开一个对话**（工具绑定发生在会话创建时）。 ### 第 4 步 —— 直接提问 ``` 追踪比亚迪最近 30 天在新能源汽车领域的竞争动态 分析近 90 天 AI 芯片行业趋势，只看 T-Score 0.8 以上的信源 调研中国人形机器人行星滚柱丝杠的市场规模、格局与进入机会 ``` *** ## ⚙️ 配置 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（`$DSH_HOME/profiles//cordis.patch.yml`）按 `id` 覆盖。**补丁整块替换 `config`，需重述全部要保留的键**： ```yaml - id: market-intelligence config: apiBaseUrl: 'http://121.43.113.132:8000' apiKeyEnv: CASEE_API_KEY defaultDays: 30 defaultMinTscore: 0.6 maxLimit: 200 timeoutMs: 30000 requestIntervalMs: 200 registerSkill: true registerPrompt: true platformUrl: 'https://casee.me' outputLanguage: auto ``` | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | `apiBaseUrl` | `http://121.43.113.132:8000` | CaSee REST 基地址（**非** 8100 MCP 端口） | | `apiKeyEnv` | `CASEE_API_KEY` | 读取密钥的环境变量名 | | `defaultDays` | `30` | 默认时间窗口（天） | | `defaultMinTscore` | `0.6` | 默认可信度门槛 | | `maxLimit` | `200` | 单次请求条数上限 | | `timeoutMs` | `30000` | 单请求超时（毫秒） | | `requestIntervalMs` | `200` | 出站请求最小间隔（毫秒），`0` 关闭限速 | | `registerSkill` | `true` | 是否注册内置技能 | | `registerPrompt` | `true` | 是否注册专家人格段落 | | `platformUrl` | `https://casee.me` | 报告 CTA 与取密钥引导链接 | | `outputLanguage` | `auto` | 报告语言：`auto`（跟随用户）/`zh`/`en` | *** ## 💬 使用 ### 六个情报工具 | 工具 | 用途 | 关键参数 | | --- | --- | --- | | `find_trusted_sources` | 按类别/地区/语言/可信度发现可信信源 | `category`、`min_tscore`、`limit` | | `search_intelligence` | 在可信信源子集内做类 Google 语法检索（主力） | `q`、`source_ids`、`days`、`min_tscore` | | `analyze_trend` | 按日/月聚合声量，找峰值与催化点 | `q`、`days` | | `aggregate_by_source` | 按信源统计报道量、平均可信度与样例标题 | `q`、`days` | | `search_with_cvc` | 检索并把命中归集到 CVC 向量模型 | `q`、`cvc_model_id` | | `semantic_search` | CVC 语义检索（BM25 + 向量 + RRF，跨语种） | `cvc_model_id`、`q`、`mode` | ### 查询语法（`q`） | 运算符 | 含义 | 示例 | | --- | --- | --- | | `+word` | AND | `+AI +芯片` | | `-word` | NOT | `+电动车 -自行车` | | `a\|b` | 同义 OR | `电动车\|EV\|NEV` | | `"phrase"` | 精确短语 | `"market share"` | | `(...)` | 分组 | `+(特斯拉\|Tesla) +(交付\|销量)` | 中文关键词由平台自动翻译为英文检索，返回 `translated_keywords` 供核对。 ### 输出契约 每次分析**同时**产出两部分，不可二选一： 1. **对话内 Markdown 摘要** —— 一句话结论 + 3–5 条关键发现（每条附 T-Score + 信源名 + 日期 + 可点链接） 2. **完整 HTML 报告文件** —— CaSee 深色看板：appbar → 封面（4 指标卡）→ 吸顶目录 → 00 结论先行 → 编号章节（含 ECharts 图表 / SWOT / 时间线 / 矩阵）→ 来源附录（编号来源 + T-Score 徽章） *** ## 🛡 T-Score 可信度体系 | T-Score | 等级 | 标识 | 使用纪律 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | ≥ 0.8 | A | 🟢 | 可直接作为决策依据 | | 0.6–0.8 | B | 🟡 | 结合上下文使用 | | 0.4–0.6 | C | 🔴 | 信号参考，必须交叉验证 | | < 0.4 | D | ⚪ | 视为传言，不作事实陈述 | **ABCD 信源分级**：A=通讯社/官方；B=主流权威；C=垂直媒体/博客；D=UGC/论坛。 *** ## 🧩 工程结构 ``` dsh-plugin-market-intelligence/ ├── package.json # dsh.bundle 清单 + 依赖 + 脚本 ├── cordis.patch.yml # bundle 补丁层（插入 market-intelligence 行） ├── tsconfig.json ├── src/ │ ├── index.ts # 插件入口：name / inject / Config / apply │ ├── config.ts # Schemastery 配置 schema │ ├── casee-client.ts # CaSee REST 客户端（归一化 + 限速 + 超时 + 错误码） │ ├── errors.ts # 结构化错误 │ ├── types.ts # 规范返回值类型 │ ├── prompt.ts # 专家人格 system-prompt 段落 │ ├── skill.ts # 运行时技能注册 │ └── tools/ # 6 个工具 + 共享 schema/渲染 ├── assets/skills/market-intelligence/ │ ├── SKILL.md # 技能正文 │ └── analysis/ # 核心流程 / 检索策略 / 市场工作流 / 报告模板 / 报告样式规范 ├── tests/ # 仿真测试（mock REST + 全流程 + 报告断言） └── .github/workflows/publish.yml # tag 触发的自动发布 ``` ### 开发命令 ```bash npm install # 构建依赖（@deepseek-ai/* 为 optional peer + devDependency） npm run typecheck # 类型检查 npm run build # 产出 lib/ npm test # 仿真测试：装载冒烟 + mock CaSee REST 全流程 + 报告断言 npm pack # 产出 dsh-plugin-market-intelligence-1.0.0.tgz ``` `npm test` 会启动进程内 mock CaSee REST 服务，用**真实插件代码**跑完整流水线，校验 6 个工具、正/负路径（`AUTH_REQUIRED` / `INVALID_ARGUMENT` / `HTTP_ERROR`）、方法学结论（Niche Go / Watch / No-Go 与否决闸门）与报告产物。产物落在 `tests/output/`。 *** ## 🩺 排错 | 现象 | 原因 | 处理 | | --- | --- | --- | | `AUTH_REQUIRED` | 未配置或密钥无效 | 到 取密钥，`export CASEE_API_KEY=...` 后**新开对话** | | `NETWORK_ERROR` / `TIMEOUT` | 端点不通或过慢 | 核对 `apiBaseUrl` 与出站网络；必要时调大 `timeoutMs` | | `RATE_LIMITED` | 调用过快 | 降低并发（≤100 次/分钟）或调大 `requestIntervalMs` | | `INVALID_ARGUMENT` | `cvc_model_id` 不合规 | 使用 `^cvc_[a-z0-9]{8,32}$`，如 `cvc_battery_anxiety` | | 工具未出现 | 未装插件 / 未重启 | `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 确认层，重启 `dsh web` | *** ## 📦 发布 ```bash npm version patch git tag v1.0.1 && git push origin v1.0.1 # 触发 .github/workflows/publish.yml ``` CI 需要仓库 Secret `NPM_TOKEN`（npm **Automation** token）。仅预演可手动运行 workflow 且不勾选 publish。

plugins.description: Favorites, copy id+path, per-session delete, idle batch archive and a favourites filter for DSH conversations — additive slot extensions over the shipped archive feature, editing no official file. 为 DSH 对话增加收藏、复制 ID+路径、单条删除、超时批量归档与收藏筛选。
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-archive-favorites-forge

**Favourites, copy id+path, per-session delete, idle batch archive and a
favourites filter for DeepSeek Harness conversations** — additive slot
extensions over the shipped archive feature. It edits **no official file**.

**给 DSH 的对话加上收藏、复制 ID+路径、单条删除、超时批量归档和收藏筛选 —— 全部挂在官方插槽上，不改官方一行代码。**

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/badge/npm-dsh--archive--favorites--forge-cb3837?logo=npm)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-archive-favorites-forge)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)
[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%E2%89%A5%200.2.0--rc.2-4f46e5)](https://github.com/loyalchiiina/dsh-archive-favorites-forge)

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

---

## Screenshots

**1. The conversation menu** — favourite, copy id + path, and a guarded permanent delete, added as three rows to the shipped 「…」 menu:

![Session menu](assets/01-session-menu.png)

**2. The favourites filter** — two extra rows in the official 筛选会话 group, narrowing the sidebar to favourites that are archived and to favourites that are not:

![Favourites filter](assets/02-favourites-filter.png)

**3. The settings panel** — idle batch archive, the favourites list with archive state, and batch delete of archived conversations that are not favourites:

![Settings panel](assets/03-settings-panel.png)

---

## Why this exists

DSH already ships an archive feature: the Workspace registry keeps a global
`archivedSessionIds` set and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-workspace` renders the
sidebar rows plus a view-options filter. That shipped feature has **no
favourites, no per-conversation delete, no copy-id/path affordance, and no
time-based batch archive** — and it deliberately refuses to open an archived
conversation.

This plugin adds those things by attaching to documented official slot points,
so it composes with the shipped UI instead of patching it.

## Features · At a glance

| | 中文 | English |
|---|---|---|
| ① | **收藏对话**：归档或未归档的对话都能收藏；「…」菜单项 + 行内 ☆，星标即时生效 | **Favourite any conversation** — archived or not; a menu row plus an inline ☆ star, applied optimistically |
| ② | **复制 ID + 路径**：「…」菜单一键复制会话 ID 与转录文件绝对路径（两行） | **Copy id + path** — one menu row copying the session id and the transcript's absolute path |
| ③ | **单条永久删除**：任意非收藏对话可删，二次确认；删完侧栏**立即移除该行** | **Per-conversation permanent delete** — any non-favourite, behind a confirmation, and the sidebar row disappears at once |
| ④ | **超时批量归档**：把闲置超过 N 小时的未归档对话一次性归档，可撤回 | **Idle batch archive** — archives conversations quiet for more than N hours, undoable |
| ⑤ | **导出清单**：制表符分隔的 txt，含**对话名称 / 对话ID / 所属工作区 / 闲置时长 / 最后活动时间**；可复制路径或直接打开所在文件夹 | **Export list** — a tab-separated txt with name, id, workspace, idle time and last-activity time; copy its path or reveal it in the file manager |
| ⑥ | **收藏筛选**：视图选项菜单新增「仅显示收藏（已归档）」与「仅显示收藏（未归档）」 | **Favourites filter** — view-options rows for favourites that are archived, and favourites that are not |
| ⑦ | **批量删除**：一键永久删除「已归档且未收藏」的对话 | **Batch delete** — permanently removes the archived-and-unfavourited conversations |
| ⑧ | **删除护栏**：收藏项拒删、越出会话根目录拒删、符号链接拒删、逐条报告、批量上限 | **Delete guardrails** — favourites refused, paths outside the sessions root refused, symlinks refused, per-id reporting, batch cap |

### Where each feature lives

| Feature | UI location |
|---|---|
| Favourite / copy / delete one conversation | Sidebar row 「…」 menu (and a hover ☆ on the row) |
| Idle batch archive, export list, favourites list, batch delete | **Settings → 归档收藏** |
| Favourites filter | **视图选项 → 筛选会话** |

## Install

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-archive-favorites-forge
```

Then **fully quit and reopen DSH**. The host half (`lib/index.js`) has no
watcher in this harness generation, and the client bundle is snapshotted at
startup — so a page refresh alone does **not** pick up a new version.

## How it works

```
lib/index.js    host half   — favourites store, transcript-path resolver,
                              JSON routes, guarded delete, archive/dearchive
lib/client.js   client half — official slot registrations + one DOM rule
```

**Slots used** (all documented in the harness client contract):

| Slot | What it contributes |
|---|---|
| `sidebar.workspaces.session.menu.item` | 3 rows: favourite, copy id+path, delete |
| `sidebar.workspaces.session.row.action` | 1 hover ☆ star |
| `settings.section` | the 归档收藏 page |

Every contribution is registered through `ctx.slots.inject` — the "register once
the owning entry is mounted" contract — so the plugin never assumes the sidebar
is up, and never holds a reference to a node the host owns.

The favourites filter is the one exception: the view-options menu is a plain
array with **no slot and no trigger id**, so that single control is added by
finding the official filter row in the DOM and cloning it. It keys on
`role`/`aria`/`data-row-key` attributes, never on the CSS-module hashes (which
are re-hashed on every build).

### Why the favourites set lives in a file, not `localStorage`

Renderer `localStorage` is origin-scoped: the desktop shell, a phone view and a
remote browser are different origins and would each keep their own stars. The
host half persists them to

```
~/.dsh/data/dsh-archive-favorites-forge/favorites.json
```

which survives a profile switch, a reinstall, and both ends.

### Why the delete is host-side and guarded

There is **no official session-delete RPC** in this harness generation — the
shipped UI never deletes a session. "Delete this conversation" therefore means
removing the session's own artifact directory under `~/.dsh/sessions/`. That is
irreversible, so the host applies these guards before it removes anything:

1. a **favourited** id is refused outright (checked host-side, not just in the UI);
2. a resolved path **outside the sessions root** is refused;
3. a **symlink** is refused;
4. the sessions root itself is refused;
5. the batch is capped by `maxDeletePerCall`.

Each id is reported separately, so one failure never aborts the batch. After a
successful delete the host emits `api-session/removed` — the harness's own
row-removal event — so the sidebar drops the row immediately instead of showing
it until the next reload.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch for the host routes |
| `maxDeletePerCall` | `500` | Hard cap on one delete request |

```yaml
- id: dsh-archive-favorites-forge
  config:
    maxDeletePerCall: 200
```

## Notes and limits

- **The id form**: session ids are spelled `session-<uuid>`, but artifact
  directories on an upgraded machine use **both** `<uuid>` and `session-<uuid>`.
  Every comparison goes through a normaliser and the resolver tries both
  spellings, so this works for old and new conversations alike.
- **Archived conversations cannot be opened** — that is shipped DSH behaviour,
  not this plugin's. Unarchive first if you want to read one.
- **Deleting is permanent.** It removes the conversation and its transcript. It
  does not touch your project working directory.
- **Blank sessions are never candidates.** A "blank" session is the provisional
  New Session slot; it has no content to archive and the shipped sidebar hides
  every blank session except the currently selected one, so a candidate list
  containing one would be impossible to verify. They are excluded from both the
  idle pool and the batch-delete set, and the export names the rest the way the
  sidebar does (`新会话` / `未命名`).
- **Candidate lists are intersected with what the sidebar actually lists.** A
  session that is archived but not rendered (no `cwd`) is never counted or
  acted on.
- The plugin reads the Workspace registry to map a session to its owning
  folder. It mutates that registry only through the registry's **own**
  `archiveSession` / `unarchiveSession` methods, and never writes another
  plugin's internals.

## Development

```
lib/index.js             host half
lib/client.js            client half (a __ModuleLoader__ bundle)
test/probe-client.mjs    DOM-stub + host probe suite
```

Run the suite:

```sh
node test/probe-client.mjs
```

The probe is not a formality — it has repeatedly caught bugs

plugins.description: Noema long-term memory plugin for DSH: durable, inspectable agent memory with recall tools and a settings page.
plugins.readme_text:
DSH Noema

Long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness — durable, inspectable agent memory backed by Noema.
Recall Before Work • Import From 9 Agent Tools • Settings-Page Memory Management • Crash Keep-Alive • Hot Reload

npm: @zseven-w/dsh-noema · Tested with DSH 0.2.0-rc.2

English · 简体中文 · 繁體中文 · 日本語 · 한국어 · Français · Español · Deutsch · Português · Русский · हिन्दी · Türkçe · ไทย · Tiếng Việt · Bahasa Indonesia


The Noema Memory settings page — import sources, memory management, and live server status

## Why DSH Noema DSH Noema connects [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) with [Noema](https://github.com/ZSeven-W/noema) — a local-first, non-vector memory system for coding agents — so an Agent keeps durable knowledge across sessions instead of starting every conversation from zero.
### 🧠 Durable Recall Memories persist as inspectable Markdown files under `NOEMA_ROOT` (default `~/.agent-memory/`). `noema_recall` loads relevant context at the start of a session; `noema_search`, `noema_browse`, `noema_catalog`, and `noema_recall_graph` cover lookup, exploration, and auditing. ### 📥 Import From Other Tools `noema_import` reads the memory files of ten other AI coding tools — Codex, Claude Code, opencode, Cursor, Grok, WorkBuddy, Antigravity, Trae, Qoder, Hermes — splits them into sections, and saves each as a durable memory. A content-keyed ledger deduplicates across runs and across tools that share files.
### 🛠️ Settings-Page Management The Noema Memory settings page configures the server command, memory root, budgets, idle/call timeouts, and the guidance section — and a Manage memories card searches, browses, adds, reviews, and deletes stored memories directly. ### 🩺 Keep-Alive The memory server stays up: idle timeout defaults to never, and a keep-alive loop restarts the `noema-mcp` child in the background when it crashes or exits, with a configurable check interval and restart backoff.
### 🔍 Smart Entity Extraction Noema's extraction engine combines jieba word segmentation with high-precision signals — English proper nouns, CJK names and technical terms, quoted topics, and repetition — with stopword and path filters, so the PageIndex topic catalog stays clean. ### ⚡ Hot Reload After the first boot, the plugin never needs a restart again: `pnpm run build` hot-reloads the host plugin through Cordis HMR, and `ppnpm run build:client` hot-swaps the browser bundle over the client-hmr SSE channel.
## Install into DSH ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @zseven-w/dsh-noema@latest dsh web ``` Or, for local development straight from the source tree: ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-noema dsh web ``` The `link:` protocol symlinks the profile dependency to this repository, so rebuilds are visible immediately and Cordis HMR can watch the compiled output. The plugin bundles the `noema-mcp` binary through per-platform optional npm packages. To build it yourself instead, run `cargo build --release -p noema-mcp` inside the bundled `noema` submodule, or point the Server command setting at any `noema-mcp` build. ## Memory Tools The model-facing tools mirror the Noema MCP surface: | Tool | What it does | | --- | --- | | `noema_recall` | Recall relevant memories for a query, with a token budget. | | `noema_search` | Full-text search over stored memories. | | `noema_browse` | Browse the PageIndex catalog for a topic or entity. | | `noema_catalog` | Render the full memory catalog as markdown. | | `noema_recall_graph` | Multi-hop recall through links and shared entities. | | `noema_neighbors` | One graph hop from a memory. | | `noema_explain` | Explain why a memory was or was not recalled. | | `noema_remember` | Save a durable fact, decision, constraint, or preference. | | `noema_review_list` | List pending review candidates. | | `noema_review_decide` | Accept, reject, edit, or merge a candidate. | | `noema_forget` | Tombstone or hard-delete a memory. | | `noema_policy_get` / `noema_policy_set` | Read or update the write policy. | | `noema_status` | Server and tenant status: counts, index health, storage root. | | `noema_import` | Import memories from other AI coding tools. | Each tool returns a uniform envelope `{ ok, tool, text }` where `text` carries the full server output. ## Import memories from other tools | Source id | Global files | Workspace files | | --- | --- | --- | | `codex` | `~/.codex/AGENTS.md` + the Codex memory pipeline: `~/.codex/memories/MEMORY.md`, `memory_summary.md`, `rollout_summaries/*.md`, `extensions/ad_hoc/notes/*.md` (`raw_memories.md` skipped — it is the uncurated feed) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `claude-code` | `~/.claude/CLAUDE.md`, `~/.claude/CLAUDE.local.md`, `~/.claude/MEMORY.md` | `CLAUDE.md`, `CLAUDE.local.md`, `MEMORY.md` | | `opencode` | `~/.config/opencode/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md` | | `cursor` | `~/.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `~/.cursorrules` | `.cursor/rules/*.mdc`, `.cursorrules` | | `grok` | `~/.grok/AGENTS.md` + the Grok cross-session memory: `~/.grok/memory/MEMORY.md`, per-project `MEMORY.md`, and `sessions/*.md` summaries | `AGENTS.md` | | `workbuddy` | `~/.codebuddy/CODEBUDDY.md` (WorkBuddy memory file), `~/.workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/.workbuddy/memory.md`, `~/.config/workbuddy/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/WorkBuddy/AGENTS.md` | `AGENTS.md`, `CODEBUDDY.md` | | `antigravity` | `~/.antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/.config/antigravity/AGENTS.md`, `~/Library/Application Support/Antigravity/AGENTS.md` (best-effort; no documented global memory store yet) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md` | | `trae` | `~/.trae/AGENTS.md`, `~/.trae/memory/`, `~/.trae/rules/` (plus the `~/.trae-cn` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `.trae/rules/` | | `qoder` | `~/.qoder-cn/AGENTS.md`, `~/.qoder-cn/rules/`, the auto-memory roots `~/.qoder-cn/memory/` and `~/.qoder-cn/projects/*/memory/` (plus `~/.qoder` variants) | `AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `.qoder/rules/` | | `hermes` | `~/.hermes/memories/` (`MEMORY.md` + `USER.md`) and the global `~/.hermes/SOUL.md` | `.hermes.md`, `HERMES.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md` | - The `source` argument selects one tool, or omit it to run every source enabled in settings. - The `path` argument selects the workspace root for project-scoped files (defaults to the session workspace; workspace files only load when the Import workspace files setting is on). - Imports are deduplicated through a ledger at `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-noema-imports.json`, keyed by file path +

plugins.description: DSH plugin — free OpenCode Zen models for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Free LLM API, no API key needed. 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode Zen 免费模型，无需 API key
