plugins.description: Cross-session artifact center for DeepSeek Harness: agent tools register deliverable files (PDF/Excel/PPT/code/JSON) into one shared folder, plus a sidebar panel that filters them by category, extension or keyword.
plugins.readme_text:
# 产物中心 · Artifact Center

> DeepSeek Harness（DSH / Cordis）插件：**agent 每次产出重要文件都会登记进一个跨会话的产物中心**，
> 左侧边栏提供面板，按分类 / 后缀 / 关键词即时筛选。

每个对话都在产出文件——报告 PDF、Excel 数据表、PPT、脚本、JSON——但它们散落在各会话的工作目录里，换个对话就找不到了。
本插件把「值得留下的产物」集中到一处：

- **agent 侧**：4 个工具。产出文件时调用 `artifact_save` 登记，默认**复制一份**到统一目录，原目录被清理也不丢。
- **用户侧**：左侧边栏「产物中心」面板。分类 chip + 后缀 chip + 关键词搜索，可复制路径、在文件夹中显示、删除。
- **跨会话**：索引与副本都在 `~/.dsh/artifact-center/`，所有对话共用同一份。

```
┌ 左侧边栏 ────────┐
│ 对话             │
│ 自动化任务       │
│ 产物中心   ← 面板行 │──┐
│ 插件管理         │  │
└──────────────────┘  │
                      ▼
┌ 产物中心 ───────────────────────────────────────┐
│ 分类  [全部] [pdf 3] [excel 2] [code 5] …     刷新│
│ 后缀  [.pdf 3] [.xlsx 2] [.py 4] [.json 1]      │
│ 搜索标题 / 文件名 / 路径 / 备注 / 标签            │
│ ─────────────────────────────────────────────── │
│ 季度报告.pdf      PDF  2.0 MB  复制路径 显示 删除 │
│ train.py          代码 4.1 KB  …                │
└─────────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

## 安装

```sh
# 从 GitHub 安装（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lishuo4096/artifact-center

# 本地开发：link 到源码目录
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/artifact-center
```

也可以在插件市场（dshmarket）里搜索 `artifact-center` 一键安装。

装完**重启 DSH**（宿主的插件模块走 ESM 缓存，改完源码或新装插件都需要重启才加载新代码）；
重启后左侧边栏出现「产物中心」，对 agent 说话时 `artifact_save` 等工具即可用。

## agent 工具

| 工具 | 参数 | 作用 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `artifact_save` | `path`（必填）、`title`、`note`、`tags[]`、`mode`（`copy` 默认 / `link`） | 登记一个产物。`copy` 会把文件复制进统一目录；`link` 只记路径不动文件 |
| `artifact_list` | `ext`、`category`、`keyword` | 列出/筛选产物，三个过滤条件可组合 |
| `artifact_stats` | — | 按分类、按后缀的计数 |
| `artifact_remove` | `id`（必填） | 删除条目。`copy` 产物连副本一起删；`link` 产物只删条目，**永不碰原文件** |

工具的返回值是结构化 JSON；`artifact_save` 的 `path` 不存在或不是文件时返回 `{ok:false,message}`，不会抛异常打断对话。

## 面板

左侧边栏「产物中心」，与工具读写同一份索引：

- **分类 chip**：`pdf` / `excel` / `ppt` / `word` / `image` / `code` / `data` / `archive` / `other`，带计数，计数为 0 且未选中的不显示。
- **后缀 chip**：按真实后缀分组（`.pdf`、`.py`、`.json`…），按数量降序。
- **搜索框**：服务端匹配标题、文件名、路径、备注、标签（输入 220ms 防抖）。
- **每行操作**：复制路径 · 在文件夹中显示（Windows `explorer /select`、macOS `open`、Linux `xdg-open`）· 删除（二次确认）。

## 数据与配置

```
~/.dsh/artifact-center/
├── index.json   # 索引：id / 原标题 / 原路径 / 存储路径 / mode / 分类 / 后缀 / 大小 / 备注 / 标签 / 所属会话 / 时间
└── files/       # copy 模式的副本
```

索引写入是串行队列（不会两个 tool 调用互相覆盖）。默认根目录是 `~/.dsh/artifact-center`，
可用插件配置 `rootDir` 覆盖：

```yaml
# cordis.patch.yml（用户覆盖层）
- id: artifact-center
  config:
    rootDir: D:/artifacts
```

## HTTP 路由（面板的数据通道）

面板通过宿主 `webServer` 的同源路由取数据，不需要额外服务：

| 路由 | 方法 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `/artifact-center/api/state` | GET | `?ext=&category=&keyword=` → `{ok, items, stats, rootDir, categories}` |
| `/artifact-center/api/remove` | POST | `{id}` → 删除条目 |
| `/artifact-center/api/reveal` | POST | `{id}` → 在文件管理器里定位；只接受索引里的 id，路径由服务端解析 |

三条路由都带**同源栅栏**：带跨站 `Origin` 的请求直接 403；写操作必须 `content-type: application/json`
（跨站表单这类「简单请求」不触发预检，声明 JSON 则会预检，而预检打到本路由必然 405/415）；
非浏览器调用（curl / node，没有 Origin）照常可用。`reveal` 不接受任意路径参数，所以无法被用来打开任意文件。

没有 `webServer` 的形态（纯 CLI）下，面板这段不激活，4 个工具照常工作。

## 目录结构

```
artifact-center/
├── package.json          # dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（web）
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 注册进 profile 的 patch 行
├── index.js              # 宿主半边：4 个工具 + 3 条同源路由
├── client.js             # 浏览器半边：侧边栏面板行 + 面板页（window.__ModuleLoader__ 形态）
├── lib/
│   ├── defineTool.js     # 作者侧工具 DSL → 宿主 JSON Schema（零依赖，必须带）
│   └── store.js          # 索引与副本的存储层（串行写、分类规则）
└── test/
    └── local-smoke.mjs   # 离线自检：81 项断言，不需要 DSH 就能跑
```

`lib/defineTool.js` 不是可选的装饰：宿主真正加载的是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 的 `defineTool`，
但在 profile 里以 `link:` 安装的插件**不能 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/*`**（它们只在 app.asar 内，Node 解析不到），
所以插件必须自带一份等价实现。作者的 `parameters` 用 `required: true` 这种 DSL 写法，`output.schema: {type:'json'}` 表示无约束 JSON。

## 开发与自检

```sh
node test/local-smoke.mjs
```

零依赖，不需要启动 DSH：伪造 `ctx` / `req` / `res` 后覆盖工具行为（复制落盘、link 不复制、删除 link 不动原文件、
筛选与统计）、三条路由（含同源/方法/content-type 栅栏）、`client.js` 的装载与渲染（用 stub React 渲染空态、
有数据、筛选无命中、错误态），以及**工具 schema 必须通过宿主 `assertSupportedJsonSchema`** 这条回归护栏
（作者侧 `type:'json'` 若被原样透传，宿主 `register()` 会同步抛错，进而中断整个 `apply()`——本插件踩过这个坑）。

## 兼容性

- 面板需要 Web GUI（宿主 `webServer` 同源路由 + `sidebar.panellist` / `main` 插槽）。
- 纯 CLI 形态下工具可用，面板不显示。
- 已在本机 DSH 桌面版（Electron，Web GUI `http://127.0.0.1:19387`）上实测：面板渲染、筛选、删除、
  在文件夹中显示，以及 4 个工具均正常。

## License

MIT

---

# Artifact Center (English)

A DeepSeek Harness (DSH / Cordis) plugin that gives every conversation a **shared artifact center**.

Agents produce files all the time — reports, spreadsheets, slides, scripts, JSON — and they end up scattered across
per-session working directories, effectively lost the moment the conversation changes. This plugin registers the
artifacts worth keeping, in one place:

- **Agent tools** — `artifact_save` (copies the file into a shared directory by default, or just records the path with
  `mode:"link"`), `artifact_list` (filter by `ext` / `category` / `keyword`), `artifact_stats`, `artifact_remove`.
- **Sidebar panel** — category chips with counts, extension chips with counts, keyword search, copy path,
  reveal in file manager, delete with confirmation.
- **Cross-session** — index and copies live in `~/.dsh/artifact-center/`, shared by every conversation.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:lishuo4096/artifact-center
```

Restart DSH afterwards. The panel talks to the host over three same-origin routes under `/artifact-center/api/`
(`state`, `remove`, `reveal`); cross-origin requests are rejected, writes require `application/json`, and `reveal`
resolves paths server-side from the index so it cannot be used to open arbitrary files.

Run `node test/local-smoke.mjs` for the dependency-free self-check (81 assertions covering the tools, the routes,
the browser bundle and the tool-schema contract).

MIT licensed.

plugins.description: Community global prompt plugin for DeepSeek Harness: durable Web Settings and system prompt injection. Preview for a pinned development snapshot.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-global-prompt

在 DeepSeek Harness 设置里保存跨会话的固定指令：一个开关、一段文本，作用于安装此插件的 profile。

[下载 v0.2.0 预览版](https://github.com/Humengjiu/dsh-global-prompt/releases/tag/v0.2.0) · [English](README.en.md) · [验证记录](docs/validation.md)

独立社区插件，由 Humengjiu 维护，采用 MIT 协议；未经 DeepSeek 官方收录。

## 兼容范围

| 插件版本 | 已验证的 dsh |
| --- | --- |
| 0.2.0 | 官方发布版 **0.2.1-alpha.2**，tag `dsh-v0.2.1-alpha.2`，提交 `d743267388641bc76f17c45ce8b4c231aed1d32c` |
| 0.1.0 | 原开发分支快照，见 [历史预览版](https://github.com/Humengjiu/dsh-global-prompt/releases/tag/v0.1.0) |

本次已在 Windows 上使用官方 npm 发布包验证 Web 安装和实际网页操作。桌面应用使用相同的 Web 插件协议，但尚未单独进行桌面安装验收。未来 dsh 版本可能改变插件 API；本包声明准确的版本要求，不需要设置兼容性豁免。

## 安装到 Web

1. 确认 dsh 版本为 `0.2.1-alpha.2`。
2. 下载 `dsh-global-prompt-0.2.0.tgz`。
3. 在终端执行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/dsh-global-prompt-0.2.0.tgz
```

然后重新启动 dsh Web，打开 **设置 → 全局提示词**。打开开关后输入固定指令，等待保存完成。

安装包自带 profile 组合层，会自动注册 `global-prompt` 条目；无需修改 dsh 源码，也不需要旧版 `--patch global-prompt.patch.yml`。含空格的文件路径请加引号。也可在 dsh 的社区插件安装界面使用该预览版安装包的下载 URL。

首次安装默认启用。若这是更新已安装的旧包，官方会保留其启用状态；设置入口未出现时，在侧栏「插件」中启用 `dsh-global-prompt`，再按提示重启。

默认关闭、文本为空。设置通过官方实时 ConfigForms 保存到对应 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`，默认 Web 路径为 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`。服务端对过期的编辑版本进行冲突检查；保存失败会显示提示，当前页面的文本草稿保留并可重试。远端连接或只读状态下不进行 Host 写入。

## 从 0.1.0 升级

旧版使用独立的 `settings.yaml` 命名空间；新版使用官方 volatile Config 和 profile patch。请保留旧文件，移除旧版启动覆盖文件的使用，再安装新版组合包。详细步骤和不覆盖原文件的迁移工具见 [升级指南](docs/upgrade-v0.2.md)。

## 行为与模型影响

启用且文本非空白时，`user:global-prompt` 在 deployment persona prefix 之后贡献原文；关闭、清空或只有空白时不贡献内容。包括 `{{variable}}` 在内的文本会按字面保留，不作为 dsh 插值表达式执行。每次组装读取当前实时配置；修改会通知提示词消费者，不重启插件。

内容增加对应的模型输入 token；修改会改变 KV-cache 前缀。作用范围是安装该组合包的 profile 内的会话。官方明确声明的完整 system prompt 会覆盖其他 section，这个规则仍然有效。

## 开发

开发依赖直接来自官方已发布的 npm 包，不再依赖克隆旧开发分支。

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm test
pnpm run build
pnpm run smoke
pnpm run pack
```

Node `^22.19.0 || >=24`，pnpm 11.28.5。构建生成 Node 入口、浏览器闭包工厂、CSS 和类型声明；预览包输出到 `dist/`。GitHub Actions 验证通过后，带版本的 tag 会发布预览包、源码包和校验文件。

## 验证与限制

已验证真实 Loader/profile 持久化与重启、官方浏览器设置/renderer/locale 工厂、保存失败草稿和重试、真实 dsh Web 安装、启用、输入、刷新恢复和关闭。具体结果见 [验证记录](docs/validation.md)。

未进行真实模型 API 调用、桌面应用安装或移动端验收。每次文本变化仍单独排队保存，尚未增加防抖。该插件没有发布到 npm，本次通过 GitHub 预览包交付。

## 来源与许可证

源于 Humengjiu 的 [原始实现](https://github.com/Humengjiu/deepseek-harness/pull/1)，保留 MIT 授权和原始版权说明，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)、[NOTICE](NOTICE)。

plugins.description: A portable memory protocol for AI agents — load it as standing rules; a curation discipline + reference spec + optional cap hook.
plugins.readme_text:
**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

# Engramory

[![CI](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tinqiao-oss/engramory/actions/workflows/test.yml)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![Python 3.9+](https://img.shields.io/badge/python-3.9%2B-blue.svg)](https://www.python.org/)

**An opinionated, zero-infrastructure memory *protocol* for small-scale, local,
file-based agent memory** — a strict curation discipline plus a validator
(`tools/engramory_doctor.py`), loaded as **standing rules** (`CLAUDE.md` /
`AGENTS.md` / your host's rules file). It is not a database, a framework, or a
relevance-loaded skill. Memory is a folder of small, human-readable markdown files
plus one always-loaded index. No database, no embeddings, no server — just
plain-text files you can open, read, edit, and diff in any editor (the live store
itself stays git-ignored).

> *Engramory* — coined from *engram* (the physical trace a memory leaves in the
> brain) + *memory*. Here: one file = one fact.

> ⚠️ **Unrelated projects share this name.** *engram + memory* is an obvious
> coinage and at least one other repository arrived at it independently. This
> project is only ever `tinqiao-oss/engramory` (npm: `dsh-engramory`); a same-named
> repo under a different owner is not a fork, a mirror, or a newer version of it.

> 🤖 **Are you an AI agent, asked to install or check this?** Start at
> **[AGENT-SETUP.md](AGENT-SETUP.md)**, not at the install steps below. It is the
> procedure for working out what your host can actually enforce, whether a store
> already exists, what you must not touch, and what to tell the user — the parts
> agents reliably get wrong when improvising.

> **Status: 0.12.1 — experimental.** The hard index cap (a `PreToolUse` hook) is
> deterministic for the matched direct-edit tools (`Edit | Write | MultiEdit`) but
> NOT a global write guard (shell tools — Bash, PowerShell, a background Monitor
> command — plus MCP file tools, external editors, and sync clients bypass it);
> the discipline loads as standing rules the model follows, so it's
> best-effort, not guaranteed on every task (see [SKILL.md](SKILL.md) §8). Assumes a
> single writer / serialized writes. Don't rely on it as a "mandatory, reliable,
> cross-agent" memory layer yet.

---

## What this is — and is NOT

Engramory is **not a new memory architecture**. The "markdown files + a small index
loaded into context + the model curates it" pattern is now the mainstream shape
for agent memory, and it ships in several places already. Engramory stands on:

- **Claude Code native auto-memory** — the same markdown-`MEMORY.md`-index +
  lazy detail-file pattern; its system prompt even uses the same
  `user | feedback | project | reference` type vocabulary (per
  [anthropics/claude-code#58840](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/58840);
  the *public docs* describe only the index + topic files). Engramory is a
  disciplined superset of this default.
- **[basic-memory](https://github.com/basicmachines-co/basic-memory)** — markdown
  source-of-truth, YAML frontmatter `type`, `[[wikilink]]` graph, local-first.
- **[obsidian-second-brain](https://github.com/eugeniughelbur/obsidian-second-brain)**,
  **[claude-memory-compiler](https://github.com/coleam00/claude-memory-compiler)**
  ("a loaded index beats vector search at personal scale"), and the broader family
  of markdown-memory skills.

What Engramory contributes is the **opinionated bundle + the discipline**, not the
primitives. Do not claim novelty on markdown, frontmatter, wikilinks, a loaded
index, one-file-per-fact notes, or curation hygiene — all are prior art.

## What's actually differentiated

1. **A role/purpose ontology, headed by `feedback` = procedural memory.** The
   semantic / episodic / **procedural** split is established prior art — the CoALA
   taxonomy, and a named procedural type in LangMem and mem0 — so Engramory does not
   claim the category. What it does is make procedural `feedback` the *spine* of a
   deliberately tiny, hand-authored, human-readable set, with required **Why:** /
   **How to apply:** lines, instead of auto-extracting it into a vector/graph store.
   The contribution is the packaging and discipline, not the ontology.

2. **The curation contract as concrete behaviour** the protocol applies (model-followed, not a hard gate): dedup-before-write,
   update-don't-duplicate, delete-when-wrong, and a negative-scope rule ("don't
   store what git/CLAUDE.md/the code already records"). Surveys consistently name
   *modify/delete/forget* as the most under-implemented memory operation — Engramory
   makes it the spine.

3. **A bounded index designed not to silently rot.** The index loads every session and
   Claude Code reads the first 200 lines / 25 KB (documented behavior), so an unbounded index silently
   drops memories off the end. Engramory warns at 150 lines / 20 KB, compacts-or-asks
   before 200 / 25 KB, and ships a hard `PreToolUse` hook backstop (it blocks only
   *growth* past the cap — shrinking/compaction edits always pass). Both the line and
   byte caps apply — whichever is hit first triggers (an index can be under the line
   count yet over on bytes when the lines run long).

   Claude Code has since followed up on this natively: v2.1.186 (released
   2026-06-22) reminds the agent to compact the index when it nears the cap, and
   v2.1.210 (released 2026-07-14) turned an over-cap write into an explicit error
   instead of a silent truncation. Both are after-the-fact alerts, though — the
   write still lands, and entries past the cap stay invisible until someone
   compacts. Engramory's hook denies the write *before* it happens, so a write
   through the matched edit tools never leaves the index over-cap in the first
   place (writes outside them — a shell, an MCP file tool — are not gated; see the
   status note above and SKILL.md §8). The native alerts validate the direction
   and make a welcome second layer — and older versions and other hosts still
   have neither.

## How it compares

| | storage | recall | human-readable | typed ontology | curation discipline | bounded index | infra |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Engramory** | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ role-based (4) | ✅ contract (model-run) | ✅ 150/200 + hook | none |
| CC auto-memory | md files | loaded index → open file | ✅ | ✅ same 4 types | partial (auto) | ~200-line window* | none (built-in) |
| basic-memory | md + SQLite | semantic/FTS search | ✅ | ✅ freeform type | schema + overwrite checks | ❌ (no loaded index) | SQLite + embeddings |
| obsidian-second-brain | md vault | index-first + search | ✅ | folder-typed | ✅ reconcile/lint | partial | none |
| mem0 / Zep | vector/graph DB | semantic | ❌ (DB) | typed (prefs/episodic/proc.; Zep custom) | auto-extract | n/a | DB + embeddings |
| [agentmemory](https://github.com/rohitg00/agentmemory) | SQLite + vector index (+opt. graph) | hybrid BM25+vector (+opt. graph), RRF | ❌ (DB/engine) | ✅ 4-tier lifecycle (work./epis./sem./proc.) | auto (capture + dedup + decay) | n/a | iii engine (local) + opt. embeddings |

Engramory's lane: **minimalism + actionable role typing + curation discipline, zero
infra.** It does *not* try to out-search basic-memory, out-scale mem0, or
out-capture agentmemory — those solve a different problem (auto-capture /
auto-ingest at volume) at a different cost point. agentmemory is the closest
heavyweight foil: also local-first, but it bets on automatic capture (lifecycle
hooks) + hybrid retrieval (BM25 + vectors + optional graph) on a SQLite/`iii`
engine, where Engramory bets on hand-curation + a tiny always-loaded index and
ships no engine at all.

\* Claude Code's [memory docs](https://docs.claude.com/en/docs/claude-code/memory)
document this exactly: *"the first 200 lines of `MEMORY.md`, or the first 25KB,
whichever comes first, are loaded at the start of every conversation."* Other hosts
vary, so the window stays configurable via the hook's env vars.

## Where it fits — and the goal

Engramory is a **portable memory *discipline*, not a

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（40+ 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 40+ plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

Its egress report goe

plugins.description: Lightweight reverse-proxy bridge for DSH web GUI - fixes WS 403 through nginx
plugins.readme_text:
# @painclown/dsh-proxy-bridge

轻量级 DSH 反向代理桥，专为 nginx 等 TLS 终结反代后面的 WebSocket 转发设计。

> 理念参考 [@riceawa/dsh-lan-gateway](https://github.com/rice-awa/dsh-lan-gateway)，感谢 riceawa 的启发。

## 解决什么问题

DSH Web GUI 的 WebSocket 连接在通过 nginx → 网关 → DSH 链路时会因 Origin/Host 不匹配返回 403。本插件跳过 same-site 检查，信任上游终结器（nginx）做访问控制，直接转发 HTTP + WebSocket 到 DSH。

## 架构

```
浏览器 ──HTTPS──> nginx (TLS 终结) ──HTTP──> Bridge (0.0.0.0:3083) ──HTTP──> DSH (127.0.0.1:3080)
                                              │
                                              ├── 密码门 (可选)
                                              ├── DSH Cookie 自动注入
                                              ├── WebSocket 透传 (raw TCP splice)
                                              └── 速率限制 / 会话撤销
```

- **HTTP**: 转发时重写 Host/Origin 到 `127.0.0.1:3080`
- **WebSocket**: socket 直接 splice 到上游，无 same-site 检查
- **密码门**: 可选的第二层认证（在 nginx 之上）
- **DSH Cookie 注入**: 自动为请求注入 DSH 认证 Cookie，无需手动处理 DSH 登录

## 安装

```bash
# 通过 DSH 插件命令安装
dsh plugin --profile web add @painclown/dsh-proxy-bridge

# 或手动安装
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
npm install @painclown/dsh-proxy-bridge
```

## 快速开始

```
# 1. 启用桥（默认 3083 → 3080）
proxy_bridge enable

# 2. 设置密码
proxy_bridge config password=dsh2026

# 3. 配置 DSH Secret（从 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml 读取）
proxy_bridge config dshSecret=<your-secret>

# 4. 检查状态
proxy_bridge status
```

## 命令

| 命令 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| `proxy_bridge status` | 查看桥状态 |
| `proxy_bridge enable` | 启动桥 |
| `proxy_bridge disable` | 停止桥 |
| `proxy_bridge restart` | 重启桥 |
| `proxy_bridge config` | 更新配置 |

### 配置示例

```
# 设置密码（至少 8 位）
proxy_bridge config password=dsh2026

# 配置 DSH Secret（自动注入 DSH 认证 Cookie）
proxy_bridge config dshSecret=vGIxivMEJblP1teRqVymk6sefy7wHMzxds9T0Unv6rE

# 启用自签名 TLS
proxy_bridge config tlsEnabled=true tlsHosts=["dsh.poxx.top","192.168.123.254"]

# 允许 LAN 免登录
proxy_bridge config lanPasswordless=true lanCidrs=["192.168.123.0/24"]

# 清除密码
proxy_bridge config password=
```

## 配置字段

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
|------|------|--------|------|
| `enabled` | boolean | `false` | 是否启动监听 |
| `port` | number | `3083` | 监听端口 (0.0.0.0) |
| `dshPort` | number | `3080` | DSH 上游端口 |
| `password` | string | `''` | 密码门（空 = 无密码） |
| `cookieName` | string | `dsh_bridge_auth` | 会话 Cookie 名 |
| `cookieMaxAgeDays` | number | `30` | Cookie 有效期（天） |
| `dshSecret` | string | `''` | DSH browser-session secret |
| `secureCookies` | boolean | `false` | Cookie 加 Secure 标志 |
| `tlsEnabled` | boolean | `false` | 启用自签名 TLS (HTTPS) |
| `tlsDays` | number | `365` | 自签名证书有效期（天） |
| `tlsHosts` | string[] | `[]` | 证书 SAN 主机列表 |
| `lanCidrs` | string[] | `[]` | 信任的 LAN CIDR |
| `lanPasswordless` | boolean | `false` | LAN/loopback 源免登录 |

## 安全特性

### 密码门

- 设置密码后，所有请求必须携带有效会话 Cookie
- 登录页：`/__bridge_login`（GET 显示表单，POST 验证密码）
- 登出：`/__bridge_logout`（POST 撤销当前会话）
- 速率限制：每 IP 每 60 秒最多 5 次登录尝试
- 密码使用 scrypt 哈希存储，明文不保存

### 会话管理

- 每个会话有唯一 ID（16 字节随机数）
- 会话 Cookie 使用 HMAC-SHA256 签名
- 登出只撤销当前会话，不影响其他
- 修改密码递增 epoch，撤销所有会话
- 状态持久化到 `~/.dsh/proxy-bridge/state.json`（0600 权限）

### DSH Cookie 注入

当客户端请求不携带 `dsh-auth-*` Cookie 时，Bridge 使用配置的 secret 自动生成并注入，使 DSH 认证透明化。

## 文件结构

```
~/.dsh/proxy-bridge/
├── state.json          # 持久化状态（Cookie secret、密码哈希、会话 epoch、已撤销会话）
└── tls/
    ├── selfsigned.crt  # 自签名证书（tlsEnabled=true 时生成）
    └── selfsigned.key  # 私钥
```

## nginx 配置示例

```nginx
server {
    listen 11007 ssl;
    server_name dsh.poxx.top;

    ssl_certificate     /path/to/cert.pem;
    ssl_certificate_key /path/to/key.pem;

    location / {
        proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:3083;
        proxy_set_header Host $host;
        proxy_set_header X-Real-IP $remote_addr;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-For $proxy_add_x_forwarded_for;
        proxy_set_header X-Forwarded-Proto $scheme;

        # WebSocket 支持
        proxy_http_version 1.1;
        proxy_set_header Upgrade $http_upgrade;
        proxy_set_header Connection "upgrade";

        proxy_read_timeout 86400;
    }
}
```

## 开发

```bash
# 构建
npx tsdown

# 部署到 DSH profile
rm -rf ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@riceawa/dsh-proxy-bridge/lib/
cp -r lib/ ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@riceawa/dsh-proxy-bridge/lib/
```

### 源码结构

```
src/
├── index.ts            # 插件入口，工具注册，生命周期管理
├── proxy.ts            # 核心代理逻辑（HTTP 转发 + WS 透传 + 认证）
├── auth.ts             # 源分类、会话签名、速率限制
├── state.ts            # 持久化状态（scrypt 密码、Cookie secret、会话管理）
├── tls.ts              # 自签名证书生成和加载
├── login.ts            # 登录页渲染、登出路径、速率限制处理
├── config-fields.ts    # 配置 schema
└── client/
    ├── index.ts        # 客户端入口
    └── bridge-card.tsx # React 配置卡片
```

## 与 dsh-lan-gateway 的区别

| 特性 | dsh-lan-gateway | dsh-proxy-bridge |
|------|----------------|-----------------|
| Same-site 检查 | 严格（Origin/Host 必须匹配） | 跳过（信任 nginx） |
| 适用场景 | 直接暴露到 LAN | 放在 nginx 后面 |
| WS 403 问题 | 需要配置 Origin 白名单 | 自动解决 |
| DSH Cookie 注入 | 无 | 有 |
| 复杂度 | 较高（request policy、upstream session） | 较低 |

## License

MIT

plugins.description: Trae LLM provider for DeepSeek Harness: reads the credential an already signed-in Trae desktop/CLI wrote, serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint on a fixed loopback port, and seeds one editable provider entry on the models page. Never writes Trae data.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-pylon-trae

> A **Trae LLM provider plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH)**.
> Repository: <https://github.com/rumilhz/dsh-pylon-trae>
> Package name: `dsh-pylon-trae` (this is the first plugin under the `dsh-pylon-` prefix).

---

## English

### What it is

This plugin adds a **Trae** provider to DeepSeek Harness. After installing it and
restarting DSH, `Settings → Models` gains one **editable** `Trae` provider whose
model list is read from the Trae installation already signed in on this machine
(Trae desktop app, or the Trae CLI).

It does **not** depend on, import, or patch `dsh-connect-trae`.

### How it works

1. It reads the credential file that the Trae desktop app or the Trae CLI already
   wrote, and decrypts it locally with its own implementation.
2. It pulls the live model directory for the signed-in edition (CN or
   international) and decodes the streaming responses.
3. It serves an OpenAI-compatible endpoint (`/healthz`, `/v1/models`,
   `/v1/chat/completions`) from a **fixed loopback port**.
4. It seeds one provider entry into the `llm-pi-ai` namespace, which is the
   namespace the Models page renders an editor for — so you can add, remove and
   test models from the UI.

**Trae's own data is read-only.** The plugin never writes to Trae's files; there
is an assertion in the code that refuses to.

### Hard prerequisites — all four

| # | Requirement | If it is missing |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | **Trae is signed in on this machine** (desktop app is easiest; the CLI counts too) | The plugin starts but exposes no models and reports "no usable credential" |
| 2 | **Port 7864 is free** (CN build; 7865 for the international build) | The loopback service cannot start, which means there is no channel at all |
| 3 | **`dsh-connect-trae` is not mounted in the profile** | Two Trae providers fight over the same route id (`trae` / `trae-global`) |
| 4 | **Windows** | The macOS / Linux code paths exist but are **untested on real hardware** |

> Installing does **not** start or restart DSH. Quit DSH completely and reopen it.
> Reloading the window is not enough.

### Install

Three routes are documented in [`发布.md`](发布.md). In short:

- **From this repository (GitHub source).** The install target is a pnpm GitHub
  spec, `github:rumilhz/dsh-pylon-trae`. Any DSH version that can add a plugin
  from a GitHub source can install it this way.
- **From the plugin market.** ⛔ **Not searchable yet.** An entry has been / will
  be submitted to the curated `awesome-dsh-plugin` catalog, but the market only
  offers sources inside that catalog, so this route works **only after that pull
  request is merged**. See [`发布.md`](发布.md).
- **From a prebuilt tarball.** `node tools/pack.mjs` produces
  `dist/dsh-pylon-trae-<version>.tgz` plus a `.sha256` and a `.manifest.txt`
  checksum pair; `node install.mjs --from <tgz>` installs it offline.

Node **≥ 22.6** can run the `.ts` sources directly (type stripping), so there is
no build step.

---

## 中文

### 这是什么

**DSH 的 Trae 供应商插件**（自研实现；不依赖、不引用、不打补丁于 `dsh-connect-trae`）。

目标形态：在「设置 → 模型」里出现一条**可编辑**、含 Trae 全量模型、能自己筛的供应商。

- 包名 `dsh-pylon-trae`，仓库名 `dsh-pylon-trae`。
- 状态/数据目录只有一个：`$DSH_HOME\.dsh-pylon-trae\`（token、`state.json`、备份、`boot.log` 都在里面）。
  旧 `.dsh-trae\` 首次启动时会自动**复制**迁移，原目录保留给用户自己清理。

> **四硬前提**见上面英文小节的表格（Trae 已登录 · 7864 空闲 · profile 里没有 `dsh-connect-trae` · Windows）。
> 装完必须**完全退出 DSH 再打开**，刷新页面不算。

### 状态（截至 2026-10-14 深夜）

> **M1~M6 是什么**：不是版本号，是**施工顺序**（M = milestone）。
> 每一步都刻意做成"做完就能单独验证"的一小段，且**顺序保证越早可用**：
> M1 只读不碰配置 → M2 让链路能说话 → M3 才把它接进「设置 → 模型」→ M4 之后就都是加功能。
> **状态口径**：✅ = 本机实测通过 · ⏳ = 没做完，或做完但**还没验收**。

| 里程碑 | 一句话：这一步在干什么 | 做完你会看到什么 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|---|
| M0 | 先把别人的插件读透、把行号钉死、选路线 | 一份带行号的现状与选路文档 | ✅ |
| M1 | 只读：找到 Trae 的凭据并解开、把线上模型清单拉下来 | 一条命令打出「读到几个账号、线上有多少模型」 | ✅ 本机 CN 79 个模型（4 个接口全 200） |
| M2 | 让本插件自己的服务能"代替 Trae 说话"（固定端口 + 协议 + 流式解码） | 打自己的端口，能收到带工具调用的流式回复 | ✅ 文本/thinking/usage/`tool_calls` 全通 |
| M3 | 把这条供应商**写进「设置 → 模型」**（workbuddy 那种可编辑条目） | 模型页出现 Trae 一行，能勾选模型、保存、重启不丢 | ✅ **真冷启动通过**（79 模型写入；二次启动 no-op） |
| M4 | 服务端：插件自带端点 + 宿主路由 + 不开 UI 的 CLI | 没有浏览器也能读账号/目录/用量/签到/测试 | ✅ 端点两条前缀都在；`/models/reload`（只读重拉）与 `/models/refresh`（只增不删写配置）已分开 |
| 卡片 | 浏览器半边：设置卡片（账号/目录/「刷新目录」/「重建清单」/用量/签到/测试） | 设置 → 插件里出现 dsh-pylon-trae 卡片，按钮点得动 | ⏳ **代码已落地**；两个离线闸门全绿。仍差真人重启后点一次 |
| M5 | 功能对齐（用量积分 / 输入框读数 / 每日签到 / 一键测试 / 图片 / 推理档位） | 上游有的那些功能逐项出现 | ⏳ **已做**：推理档位映射、用量/签到/测试端点与卡片按钮。**未做**：输入框积分读数 + 账号浮层。**图片输入刻意不做**：协议层不翻译 `image_url`，于是目录也不宣告 `image`（理由写在 `src/protocol.ts` 顶部） |
| M6 | 收尾：把上游 `dsh-connect-trae` 从 profile 移除 | 选择器里只剩本插件那一条 Trae | ⏳ |

**验证全部跑在临时 profile 上**：`<工作区>\_trae-coldstart\home`（独立 `DSH_HOME`，里面**只**装本插件）。
把插件装进真 profile（`~/.dsh/profiles/*`）是**部署动作**。

### 怎么验（全部可复制）

把 `<node>` 换成你本机的 Node ≥ 22.6 可执行文件（DSH 自带的那份即可）：

```bat
set NODE=<node>
```

#### ① 服务端离线回归（不联网、不花额度）—— 当前 **10/10 套件 PASS**

```bat
%NODE% tools\_run-suites.mjs
```

任一失败即退出码非 0（缺脚本记 SKIP，**不算过**）。想单跑某一项（排查时更省时间，**退出码 0 才算过**）：

```bat
%NODE% tools\check-entry.ts        :: 入口能 import、Config 校验（本机：ENTRY OK）
%NODE% tools\test-seed.ts          :: 写路径 create/present/refresh/回滚 + 备份保留策略（真文件系统 e2e）
%NODE% tools\test-api.ts           :: 端点处理函数
%NODE% tools\test-reasoning.ts     :: 推理档位映射
%NODE% tools\client-bundle-check.mjs  :: 卡片 bundle
%NODE% tools\client-route-check.mjs   :: 宿主路由 handler，走真 HTTP
```

> `tools/test-seed.ts` 与 `client-*.mjs` **自己不打总数**（只打 `ALL CHECKS PASSED` / `N/N`），
> 所以判据始终是**退出码 0**，不是某一行的数字。

再加两项**联网只读**检查（只拉目录、只起回环服务，不产生生成、不花额度）：

```bat
%NODE% tools\_run-suites.mjs --network
```

#### ② 冷启动验收（起真 DSH 进程）—— 当前 **19/19**

```bat
%NODE% tools\coldstart-verify.mjs
```

它自己会：重建临时 profile → 起真 DSH（显式给 `DSH_HOME`）→ 轮询
`$DSH_HOME\.dsh-pylon-trae\boot.log` 与 profile patch → 断言 `seed: created` → 断言
`providers.trae` 与模型数 > 0 → 用 Bearer 打 `http://127.0.0.1:7864/admin/status` 得到 `ok:true`
→ 停进程 → **再起一次**断言 `seed: present` 且 patch sha256 未变 → 打印结论与耗时，并确认 7864 已释放。

```bat
%NODE% tools\coldstart-verify.mjs --keep-profile
%NODE% tools\coldstart-verify.mjs --skip-restart
%NODE% tools\coldstart-verify.mjs --capture
%NODE% tools\coldstart-verify.mjs --timeout 120 --port 7864 --dsh-profile unset
```

> **铁律不变**：脚本只写工作区下的 `_trae-coldstart\`（临时 `home\` 加上它自己的 PID 账本
> `coldstart-pids.json`、可选捕获日志），**不引用**活体 `~/.dsh`；启动的每个进程都记账，
> 结束前连子进程一起杀，并复查端口。它**能重复跑**。

#### ③ 真机六条用法（不需要 UI；只有 `test` 花一点点额度，`refresh` 可能写配置，其余只读）

```bat
%NODE% tools\trae.ts status
%NODE% tools\trae.ts models --limit 30
%NODE% tools\trae.ts usage
%NODE% tools\trae.ts checkin
%NODE% tools\trae.ts test --model mimo-v2.6-flash
%NODE% tools\trae.ts refresh --host
```

· `status` —— 账号（desktop + CLI）+ 模型数 + 当前凭据（只有 `sha256[0:12]` 指纹）
· `models --limit 30` —— 实时目录逐条列出：id / 名字 / 上下文 / 输入模态 / 所属 function
· `usage` —— 总额与各 pack 的 `credits_amount`（只读，不花额度）
· `checkin` —— 今日签到状态（只读）；**加 `--claim` 才真的领**，那会改变账号状态
· `test --model <id>` —— ⚠️ 会向 Trae 发一条极小真实消息，**消耗一点点额度**
· `refresh --host` —— 让**正在运行的宿主**重建清单（只增不删；需要 7864 上已经有宿主在跑）

#### ④ 客户端半边的两个离线闸门（不需要浏览器）

```bat
%NODE% tools\client-bundle-check.mjs
%NODE% tools\client-route-check.mjs
```

`client-bundle-check` 查：经典脚本可加载、席位注册、无任何凭据、四个状态都渲染，外加：
**「刷新目录」必须打到 `POST /models/reload`、「重建清单」必须打到 `POST /models/refresh`**（两者不许互换）、
reload 之后目录行里的 `模型 N 个` **只出现一次**、`accountWarning` 原样透传到卡片（红字）。
`client-route-check` 查：两条前缀路由、disposer 反注册、失败一律回 `{ok:false,detail}`，
以及**栅栏口径**——只有「Host 与 Origin 都是回环」的 403 被容忍（且只 trace 一次），
401 永不放过，非回环 Host/Origin 仍然 403。

这两个数字**会继续长**，所以只当"跑没跑过"的判据：**退出码 0 才算过**。

#### ⑤ M1 只读探针（原来的入口，仍然可用；不联网不花额度）

```bat
tools\probe-m1.cmd --no-network
```

去掉 `--no-network` 就是**再拉一次实时模型目录**（会联网，只读）。

### 已知限制（都会静默失败，所以写在这里）

**① 卡片这条通道依赖宿主的两件事，任一件变了卡片就整片 403。**

卡片的数据走宿主 web server 上本插件自己注册的路由（`/plugins/dsh-pylon-trae` 与 `/api/plugins/dsh-pylon-trae`），
而请求要过宿主自己的栅栏 `connection.requestRejection`。桌面 app 的 UI 层只转发 `/api/*`，
并且会把 Host 改写成宿主端口、Origin 仍是 app 端口 —— 于是同一个栅栏**对回环请求也回 403**。

我们的处理是**容忍这一种 403**（Host 与 Origin **都是回环**，端口可不同）：仅此情形放行并 trace 一次；
**401 绝不放行**，非回环 Host/Origin 仍然 403。

⇒ 若某天宿主改了这套判据，症状是卡片五个区块**全是**
`HTTP 403 … 没有返回 JSON（这条路没被转发到插件）`。**先看 `$DSH_HOME\.dsh-pylon-trae\boot.log` 里有没有这行**：

```

# dsh-win-pwsh7

简体中文 · English

把**真正的 PowerShell 7** 交给 Windows 上的 Harness `pwsh` 工具，而不是悄悄退回 Windows PowerShell 5.1。三件事： 1. **检测**这台机器上的 PowerShell 7（含你设置的 `overridePath`）； 2. **校验**你给出的路径（`pwsh7_status` 的 `path` 参数）； 3. **安装**：从 **Microsoft Store** 装（`pwsh7_install`，或配置里的 `installIfMissing`）—— **只有这一条路**，动手前先读连接成本，因为 Windows 会在计量连接上推迟商店下载。不想装，就把本插件关掉。 **它不自带 PowerShell，也不写你的配置。** 安装永远是显式动作（你要的工具调用，或你打开的配置项）；它从不卸载任何东西。 > 本文是简体中文版；完整证据与出处（含官方文档链接、逐条实测记录）在 [README.en.md](README.en.md)。 ## 安装本插件 ```powershell # 从 GitHub 安装（推荐：锁定 tag，上游后续推送不会悄悄改变已装版本） dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:XinSpark/dsh-win-pwsh7#v0.12.1 # desktop 换成你在用的 profile —— `dsh plugin list` 能看出来是哪个 ``` - **npm**：`dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-win-pwsh7`（亦可 `npm i dsh-win-pwsh7` 直接用） - **本地开发**：`npm pack`，然后 `dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:<生成的 .tgz 绝对路径>` 装完**重启 DSH**，然后在插件页（或让模型调 `pwsh7_status`）看它读到的运行时；需要接线时，把报告里给出的 profile 补丁**整段**粘进 `~\.dsh\profiles\\cordis.patch.yml` 再重启。**它不会替你改执行器的 `pwshPath`** —— 这是刻意的（见下）。 本插件**纯 JavaScript、零运行时依赖、Windows 专用**；宿主半只在 Windows 上做有意义的事，客户端半就是一张普通网页卡片。 ## 为什么需要它 Desktop 适配器按这个顺序解析 PowerShell 可执行文件： 1. `C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe` 2. `PATH` 里的每一项（**商店版**就是通过它的执行别名在这里被找到的） 3. `C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe`（5.1） 在 5.1 上，`&&` 和 `||` 是**解析错误** —— 模型写下的每条带 `&&` 的命令都会在运行前直接失败。 ## 安装 PowerShell 7：一条路，一个替代 [微软官方安装文章](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/powershell/scripting/install/install-powershell-on-windows?view=powershell-7.6) 把 WinGet 列为 Windows 客户端的推荐方式，而商店包列出的第一条好处是「**随 Windows 自动更新**」。本插件只提供这个论据支持的方案： | 方案 | 内容 | |---|---| | **① 从 Microsoft Store 安装**（插件唯一的安装路径） | `pwsh7_install` 以后台作业运行 `winget install --id 9MZ1SNWT0N5D --source msstore`（[商店条目](https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9mz1snwt0n5d)）。自更新、按用户安装、不需要提权。**连接被标为计量时 Windows 会推迟它**（见下），补救是那个设置，**永远不是换一个安装器**。 | | **② 禁用本插件** | 这台机器不需要 PowerShell 7 时，在插件页把它关掉：建议与两个工具都停止，什么也不安装。注意 `pwsh` 工具仍会失败（执行器固定了一条不存在的路径），所以那是对 `pwsh` 本身的决定。 | **没有 `route` 参数**，面向模型的任何文本（工具描述、报告、提示段）里都没有第二个安装器。开发期实测并**否掉**的两个替代方案只作历史留档，不作为选项： - `winget install --id Microsoft.PowerShell --source winget`（7.6.0 起默认装 **MSIX**，`--installer-type wix` 才装 per-machine MSI）：它的 AppX 阶段会**第二次**拉取那个 336 MiB 的包，本机因此超时 `0x80072EE2`；7.7.0 起更没有 MSI 了。 - per-machine MSI：需要**交互式提权**，本插件的宿主进程拿不到（失败码 `1622`）。 两者都不会被 Windows 自动更新 —— 这正是"商店是唯一路径"的理由。 ### 商店路线在计量连接上会「永远排队」 这是最费时间的一个坑，因此把证据留下（实测于 2026-10-14）： 1. `winget install --id 9MZ1SNWT0N5D --source msstore` 走到 `Started MSStore package execution` 之后就一直等 —— 无限期。 2. 商店自己的日志（`Microsoft-Windows-Store/Operational`）**既没有警告也没有错误** —— 所以它看起来像队列卡死，而不是失败。 3. 它的遥测显示请求带着 **`AllowDownloadOnAnyNetwork = 0`**，而连接报告 **`NetworkCostType = Fixed`**，也就是这个 Wi-Fi 配置文件被标成了「按流量计费的连接」。 4. 唯一有进展的一次，是**人**在商店界面里发起的（`IsInteractive = 1`，`ClientAppId = …Microsoft.WindowsStore…StartProductInstallWithOptionsForUserAsync`）。 5. 把连接**取消**计量标记之后，**同一条非交互**路线不到一分钟就装完了（`IsInteractive = false`，`ClientAppId = …WinGetCli-winget-StartProductInstallWithOptionsAsync`），winget 当天第一次以 0 退出。 这条策略有官方文档依据：[Windows 中的按流量计费的连接](https://support.microsoft.com/zh-cn/windows/experience/connectivity-networking/metered-connections-in-windows)（[英文](https://support.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/experience/connectivity-networking/metered-connections-in-windows)）写明计量连接会限制自动下载；微软 Q&A 里也有[同症状的帖子](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/answers/questions/5494248/microsoft-store-stuck-on-queuing-a-download-for-ov)。 所以 `pwsh7_install` **动手前**先读一次连接成本（用 Windows PowerShell 5.1 走 WinRT —— 只有它能从脚本里访问 WinRT），命中计量就**点名网络**，而补救永远只有一步： - 设置 → 网络和 Internet → WLAN → **那个网络** → 关掉「按流量计费的连接」，然后再跑一次。 **不提供第二个安装器**：计量连接是连接设置的问题，不是离开商店的理由。读不到成本就**完全不出声** —— 插件不猜。 ### 失败退出码只是证据，不是判决 商店路线也可能在运行时已经落地的情况下仍非零退出（实测一次退出 1 之后不久，PowerShell 7 就在位了）。插件因此在 winget 退出后**有界重探**（8 次 × 15 秒）才报失败，并把重探写在作业进度行上。判决永远是运行时，不是退出码：报「`winget exited with code 1` 但 PowerShell 7 已在位」时结论是**已安装**，那条误导性的退出码只作详情保留 —— 判词也不再声称是 winget 完成的，因为它无从知道。 ### 两种商店路径形态：只有一种能 pin | 形态 | 例子 | 能 pin 吗 | |---|---|---| | **家族别名** | `…\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\Microsoft.PowerShell_8wekyb3d8bbwe\pwsh.exe` | **能** —— 目录就是包家族名，不含版本号，跨商店更新存活 | | **根别名** | `…\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\pwsh.exe` | **能** —— 同一套执行别名机制，也不含版本。执行器在宿主进程内的自探测常返回这一条，而 profile 行里 pin 的是按家族的那一条；两条都接受 | | 版本号目录 | `C:\Program Files\WindowsApps\Microsoft.PowerShell_7.6.6.0_x64__8wekyb3d8bbwe\pwsh.exe` | **不能** —— 每次商店更新都会移动它，pin 在它上面的补丁会静默失效 | 别名是零长度重解析点（`Length=0`、`ReparsePoint`），Windows 通过 AppInfo 包激活解析它。实测（2026-10-13，PowerShell 7.6.6）： - 别名能在 Harness `pwsh` 工具下启动； - **ACL 沙箱对它运行的东西仍然生效**：会话处于 `workspace-write` 时，会话工作区内的写入成功，而工作区外两处常规可写路径（`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\…` 与另一卷上的路径）被拒并报 `UnauthorizedAccessException`，且没有产生任何文件。 残余风险如实说明：包激活没有文档化，所以别名是"今天能用"的 pin，不是契约。报告里会写明这一点，`pwsh7_install` 是它万一失效时的出路。 ### MSIX/商店运行时不会做什么 - 不会出现在 `C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\`（那是 MSI 的位置）； - 不会让执行器"自己找到它" —— 所以需要那条 profile 补丁指向别名； - 更新由 Windows/商店负责 —— 这既是选它的理由，也意味着**换用别的安装方式就失去自动更新**。 ## 两个工具 ``` pwsh7_status [path] 报告现在跑的是什么；校验你给的路径；给出可粘贴的 pin 补丁 pwsh7_install 从 Microsoft Store 安装 PowerShell 7，以后台作业运行并立刻返回作业号， 用 job_output 看进度、job_kill 停止。无参数：安装路径只有一条 ``` `pwsh7_install` 是有副作用的工具：只在用户明确要求时装。它会拒绝重复安装（已有普通 PowerShell 7 **或**可用的商店别名时报「already in place」），并且从不卸载 PowerShell —— 卸载插件不会动你的 PowerShell。另一个答案是**禁用插件**。 ### 安装为什么是后台作业 这个工具的第一版 `await` 了 winget，在这台机器上的结果是一次**静默 12 分钟的调用**：winget 已经把包交给商店，而商店的下载正躺在队列里等人点一下，调用看起来就像挂了，直到被中途放弃。阻塞式调用没法显示这些；作业可以。 于是 `pwsh7_install` 把安装登记进平台自己的作业注册表（`ctx.jobs`，kind `pwsh7`）并立刻返回作业号。用 `job_output` 读、`job_kill` 停 —— 都是平台自带的工具，插件不再自己造一个进度工具。 ### 进度从哪来 winget 往管道里不写有用的东西：stdout 被接管时它不画进度条，只打印几行，实测一次运行在单个静默的 `StagePackageAsync` 里待了 **4 分 15 秒**。它自己的诊断日志才是真正的数据源，所以作业跟随最新的 `…\Packages\Microsoft.DesktopAppInstaller_8wekyb3d8bbwe\LocalState\DiagOutputDir\WinGet-*.log`，把阶段行变成进度行，并把日志原文追加进作业输出： | winget 日志行 | 进度行 | |---|---| | `Downloading to path:` | updating the winget source | | `Packaged source open` | winget source ready | | `Installer hash verified` | installer downloaded and verified | | `Starting StagePackageAsync` | deploying the package（staging 覆盖下载） | | `Starting RegisterPackageByFullNameAsync` | registering the package | | `Leaf command succeeded` | winget finished | 那份日志是别的程序的私有格式，所以这里按"尽力而为"设计：找不到或读不了就退回耗时行（超过十分钟再叠加路线的停滞提示）。 ### 下载字节与速度 winget **完全不报数字进度**。这不是读取方式的问题：PTY 实测（它画界面的终端里）只有转圈、零个百分比、以及终端的"不确定进度"信号 `OSC 9;4;3` —— winget 自己就不知道百分比。 所以数字自己量：安装包落在 `%TEMP%\WinGet\<包id>.<版本>\`，作业每次心跳统计这些字节，用增量算速度；当日志里出现的安装 URL 用 `HEAD` 回答 `content-length` 时，进度行还会带上百分比： ``` running 2m — deploying the package (staging covers the download) — downloaded 120.4 MiB / 335.9 MiB (36%) @ 4.5 MiB/s ``` 字节与速度一旦磁盘上有东西就会出现；只有百分比取决于服务器是否肯报长度。 ## 模型被告知什么，以及为什么不靠工具描述 pin PowerShell 7 的意义在于 **`&&` 和 `||` 在那里能用、在 Windows PowerShell 5.1 里是解析错误** —— 模型必须知道当前是哪一个。插件发布**一个提示段**，与报告用同一次读数刷新： ``` The `pwsh` tool on this machine runs PowerShell 7.6.6, so `&&` and `||` work in one command. ``` 当某行 pin 的是 Windows PowerShell 5.1 —— 或这台机器根本没有 PowerShell 7（执行器回落到 5.1）—— 同一行会说这两个运算符是解析错误、请用 `;` 串联。第三种状态有自己的句子：某行 pin 的 `pwshPath` **已不存在**时，执行器用这个 pin 且不回落，每次调用都会以启动失败告终 —— 提示段会说明这一点，并给出**两条路**（从商店安装 / 禁用插件），这样模型第一次就能说清，而不是靠浪费调用去重新发现： ``` The `pwsh` tool cannot start: an executor row pins C:\…\pwsh.exe, which does not exist. … ``` 其他情况什么都不渲染：**它从不猜**。成本：在 pin 了 PowerShell 7 的机器上约 25 token，另两种正常状态为零，只有工具真的坏掉时约 45 token。 **为什么用提示段而不是 `pwsh` 工具自己的描述**（读者会先想到的那个缝）：工具系统没有"描述钩子"，`systemPrompt.tools()` 的提供者是**拼接**而不是覆盖，加第二个 `pwsh` schema 只会造出一个重复工具。提示段是真正存在的那个缝。 ## 配置（全部可选） | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `overridePath` | 未设 | 优先级①的显式 `pwsh.exe`。必须能启动并报告 PowerShell 7+；未通过校验就静默回落到自动探测 | | `installIfMissing` | `false` | 启动时若没有可用的 PowerShell 7，就后台安装（等价于 `pwsh7_install`），结果写进状态报告 | 两项都是 `volatile()`：插件页的配置卡改完保存即生效，不需要重启。也可以直接写进 profile 补丁： ```yaml - id: win-pwsh7 config: overridePath: 'D:\tools\pwsh\pwsh.exe' installIfMissing: true ``` ## 报告示例（本机：商店家族别名，用补丁接线） ``` Executor rows: pwsh-sandbox : pwshPath = C:\Users\...\WindowsApps\Microsoft.PowerShell_8wekyb3d8bbwe\pwsh.exe (PowerShell 7.6.6, Store family alias) desktop-windows-pwsh-sandbox : pwshPath = C:\Users\

# dsh-agent-quant-cn

国内市场量化系统的**工具面**：把 CTP 模拟盘的操作暴露成会话内可直接调用的 DSH 工具。 它自己不实现任何策略或连接逻辑——那些在 `projects/self/agent-quant/`（Python 数值层 + JSON CLI）。 本插件只做「工具面 → 取凭据 → CLI → Python」这一层薄转发。 ## 快速开始 **1) 装依赖**（在目标 profile 的 `package.json` 加 link 依赖）： ```jsonc "dsh-agent-quant-cn": "link:E:/alice/self-plugins/dsh-agent-quant-cn" ``` **2) 挂组合**： ```yaml - id: dsh-agent-quant-cn name: dsh-agent-quant-cn ``` **3) 30 秒验证**：`quant_ctp_status` → 应返回模拟盘交易前置登录 + 结算确认 + 资金与持仓 ## 能力（工具） | 工具 | 作用 | 底层 | |---|---|---| | `quant_ctp_status` | CTP 模拟盘体检：交易前置登录 + 结算确认 + 资金与持仓 | `ctp_cli.py ctp_status` | | `quant_ctp_account` | 资金与持仓明细（不做连接体检） | `ctp_cli.py ctp_account` | **故意不提供 `ctp_quote`（行情）**：`mdapi` 在该 CLI 内会段错误（0xC0000005，见任务板 `t-d6ac0958`）。 状态回包里如实披露 `market_data.status = KNOWN_BLOCKER`，不把它包装成一个看起来能用的工具。 行情数据请走回测侧（akshare）。 ## 配置 | 键 | 默认 | 说明 | |---|---|---| | `enabled` | `true` | 只认显式 `false`——未配置视为启用 | | `ctpPython` | `E:\alice\.dsh\venvs\ctp-win\Scripts\python.exe` | **必须**是 Windows 侧 venv | | `ctpCliPath` | `E:\alice\projects\self\agent-quant\scripts\ctp_cli.py` | JSON CLI | | `ctpUser` | `20661` | openctp 公开测试账号（**非密**） | | `ctpBroker` | `9999` | openctp TTS 柜台 | | `vaultScript` | `E:\alice\projects\self\alice-identity\scripts\vault.ps1` | 取值脚本（DPAPI） | | `vaultSite` | `openctp-7x24` | vault 条目名 | | `timeoutMs` | `60000` | 单次调用超时 | ⚠ **路径是锚点不是真源**（AGENTS.md §5.16）：换机、换 venv 位置时改配置，不要改代码。 ## 运行环境 - **CTP 必须跑 Windows venv**（`ctp-win`：Python 3.12 + `openctp-ctp` 6.7.11，已 `openctp-channels switch tts`）。 CTP 预编译库在本机 WSL 上 import 即崩，且 openctp 用的是 TTS 柜台——直接用官方 CTP 库连会报 4097。 - **凭据零落盘**：口令只在「vault 取 → 注入子进程 env → 用完即弃」这条线上存在。 不进配置、不进日志、不进工具返回；错误消息里**只带 stderr，绝不带 stdout**（stdout 是明文）。 取不到时**响亮失败**（空 ≠ 拿到）——空口令冒充成功会让下游以看不出原因的登录失败告终。 ## 生效判据 挂载后在会话里直调 `quant_ctp_status`，应返回真实读数： `ok=true` / `loggedIn=true` / `settled=true`，且 `accounts` 含非空资金字段。 | 症状 | 先看哪里 | |---|---| | `vault 退出码 2` | vault 文件不存在 | | `vault 退出码 3` | DPAPI 解密失败（换用户/换机器即如此） | | `vault 返回空值` | 条目存在但没有 `password` 字段 | | `无法启动解释器` | `ctpPython` 路径腐化 | | `CLI 退出码 6` | 凭据未注入到 CLI（env 变量名对不上） | | `login 3` | 柜台拒绝——用户名或口令不对 | ## 回退 改 `E:\alice\.dsh\profiles\web\cordis.patch.yml`：把该插件行的 `disabled` 置 `true`（配置改动约 2 秒热重载，无需重启）。 ## 边界（不可协商） - **只连模拟盘，不碰真钱**。真实下单必须主人逐次授权，且**不走本插件**。 - 不做策略、不做回测、不下单——这些能力在 Python 层，本插件不复制它们。 ## 测试 ```bash cd self-plugins/dsh-agent-quant-cn && npm test ``` **22 条用例**（跑一次得到）。 ## 相关文档 - [`docs/semantic.md`](docs/semantic.md) —— **权威契约**（定位/反定位 · 验收表） - 中心仓：[alice-digital-life](https://github.com/jonah791/alice-digital-life)

# dsh-session-delete

Add a **Delete Session** action to the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai) (DSH)
sidebar. Choosing it permanently removes the Session's stored log and its projection cache, and
drops the sidebar row without a page reload.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> **This project was written by AI.** The code, this README, and every other file in this
> repository were produced by an AI coding agent (see [AI authorship](#ai-authorship)). It was
> reviewed and tested against a real DSH install before publication, but you should treat it as
> AI-generated software: read the source before you run it, and expect rough edges outside the
> paths that were exercised.

---

## Why this plugin exists

DSH has no API for deleting a Session. As of the versions this was built against:

| Candidate | What it actually does |
| --- | --- |
| `sessionController` (Host `ctx.remote.session`) | `resolveAgent` / `inspect` / `list` / `search` / `create` / `selectModel` / `rename` / `fork` / `prompt` / `cancel` / `page` / `projections` — **no delete** |
| `sessionPersistence` | `create` / `open` / `flush` / `stat` / `list` — an append-only log, **no delete** |
| `workspaceRegistry.delete(id)` | Deletes a *Workspace registration* while deliberately retaining the directory and **every Session log** |
| `sessions` (client) | `retain` / `using` / `refreshProjections` / `search` / `fork` / `scope` / `binding` — **no delete** |

So the only way to offer the feature is to compose the official seams in the right order. This
plugin does exactly that, and nothing else.

## How it works

The Host half registers one loopback route, `POST /plugins/session-delete/delete`, and the browser
half adds a row to each Session's `...` menu that calls it.

Deletion runs as five steps:

1. **Stop the Session** — `workspaceRegistry.archiveSession(id, { stopActivity: true })`. This is
   the official "stop this Session's activity" path; it fans out `workspace/session-stop`, which
   `dsh-agent`, `dsh-jobs`, `dsh-schedule` and `dsh-subagent` all listen to.
2. **Detach the live Session** — `ctx.sessions.store.get(id).detach()`. The store keeps entries in
   a non-public map, and calling the entry's own `detach` is the single seam that raises
   `session/disposed`.
3. **Remove the sidebar row** — `session/disposed` → `api-session/removed`
   (`dsh-api-session-controller`) → `ctx.remote.$on("api-session/removed", …)` on the client. That
   chain is the only reason the row disappears without a reload.
   A **cold** Session (one restored from disk that was never opened in this process) has no store
   entry, so `detach` cannot fire. For that case the plugin emits `api-session/removed` itself —
   the same signal, by the same name. Nothing on the Host listens for that event, so this is
   side-effect free.
4. **Forget the membership** — `detachSession` on every Workspace, plus `unarchiveSession` and
   `unpinSession`, so no archived or pinned ghost survives.
5. **Remove the bytes** — the artifact directory under `$DSH_HOME/sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<id>/`
   and the projection cache at `$DSH_HOME/storages/session_projcache/sessions/<id>.json`.

The SQLite session index is *derived* from persistence state, so it converges on its own during the
next reconcile — the plugin does not touch it.

### Files touched on disk

Everything the plugin removes lives under `$DSH_HOME` (default `~/.dsh`):

```
$DSH_HOME/
  sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<session-id>/session.v4.jsonl[.zstd]   <- removed
  storages/session_projcache/sessions/<session-id>.json         <- removed
  storages/workspace.json                                       <- membership updated in place
```

## Install

The plugin installs as a **profile bundle**, using DSH's own plugin command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Smile-Wood/dsh-session-delete
```

From a local checkout instead of a git host:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add C:\path\to\dsh-session-delete
```

Use the profile you actually launch DSH with (`web` is the DSH Desktop default, and is also what
`dsh plugin …` assumes when you omit `--profile`). `dsh` is a shim into the packaged CLI, placed on
`PATH` once DSH Desktop has been started at least once.

> [!NOTE]
> **The repository must be public for the `github:` shorthand.** pnpm probes the HTTPS URL first and
> only falls back to SSH when that probe fails, which is what happens for a private repository or a
> nonexistent one. On a machine where outbound SSH (port 22) is blocked, that fallback fails with
> `ssh: connect to host github.com port 22: Connection refused`. For a private repository, use an
> explicit HTTPS spec and let git's credential helper authenticate:
>
> ```sh
> dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/Smile-Wood/dsh-session-delete.git
> ```

Then reload the DSH page in your browser so it picks up the browser bundle, and open a Session's
`...` menu in the sidebar. **DSH itself does not need restarting.**

To update after new commits land, re-run the same command:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Smile-Wood/dsh-session-delete
```

Re-running `add` *is* the update path: pnpm re-resolves the ref, and a changed shipped file lands in
a new content-addressed store directory, so DSH imports a **new module URL** and the Host half
genuinely reloads. See [Host reload semantics](#host-reload-semantics).

To remove it again:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-session-delete
```

That prunes the dependency, drops the name from `dsh.profile.bundles`, and unloads both halves —
verified live: the route stops answering and the browser bundle leaves the client-module graph.

> [!NOTE]
> For a **local-path** install the profile entry is a `link:`, and pnpm was observed to leave the
> symlink at `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-session-delete` behind after a `remove`.
> It is inert, but delete it by hand if you want the tree clean. Git installs are unaffected.

### What `dsh plugin add` actually does

`dsh plugin` is a thin front end for pnpm: it forwards its arguments to pnpm **inside the profile
directory** (`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/`). The part that makes the plugin load is what DSH does
next — it reconciles the profile manifest and, for every dependency that was just added and declares
a `dsh.bundle.patch`, appends its package name to `dsh.profile.bundles`:

```jsonc
// $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/package.json, after the add
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-session-delete": "git+https://github.com/Smile-Wood/dsh-session-delete.git"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": [
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
        "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
        "…existing bundles…",
        "dsh-session-delete"        // <- appended by the add
      ]
    }
  }
}
```

`dsh.profile.bundles` is the **only** thing that decides what loads. That array is why one command
is sufficient and no `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml` row is required.

A dependency that declares no `dsh.bundle` is installed as a plain dependency and skipped, with a
warning:

```
dsh: warning: <name> declares no dsh.bundle — installed as a plain dependency, not a profile layer
```

The bundled [`cordis.patch.yml`](cordis.patch.yml) is the patch this profile layer reads:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: session-delete
      name: 'dsh-session-delete'
```

`name` is the **package name**, not a path — the profile resolves it from its own `node_modules`.

> [!NOTE]
> `client.js` registers itself under the name `dsh-session-delete`, which must stay
> **character-for-character identical** to `name` in `package.json`. client-modules derives the
> browser bundle's id from the enclosing `package.json` and rejects a bundle that registers under
> anything else — and the only symptom is a menu row that silently never appears.

## Host reload semantics

Node's ESM registry caches modules by **resolved URL** and offers no invalidation hook. That has one
practical consequence:

> **Editing an installed `host.js` in place does not take effect in a running DSH.**

How much that bites depends on how you installed:

- **From git**, pnpm copies the package into its content-addressed store. A changed file produces a
  new store dire

plugins.description: Profile-level skill manager for DeepSeek Harness: a flat skill inventory with enable/disable, discovery diagnostics and a restorable trash, in a sidebar panel.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-skill-mgr

**Every skill in one list** — the whole profile inventory in a sidebar panel: see what is installed, read a skill's body, enable or disable it, repair a discovery problem, and delete it into a trash you can restore from.

**English** | [简体中文](README.zh-CN.md)

[![License](https://img.shields.io/github/license/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr?style=flat-square)](LICENSE)
[![Release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/releases)
[![CI](https://img.shields.io/github/actions/workflow/status/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/ci.yml?branch=main&style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![Last commit](https://img.shields.io/github/last-commit/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/commits/main)
[![Stars](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/stargazers)
[![PRs welcome](https://img.shields.io/badge/PRs-welcome-brightgreen?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/icrefin/dsh-skill-mgr/pulls)
[![Node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.19-339933?style=flat-square&logo=node.js)](https://nodejs.org)
[![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.0--rc.2-4B5563?style=flat-square)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)

> If this plugin saves you a hunt through `~/.dsh/skills`, a ⭐ star helps the next person find it.

## Why this exists

A skill is a folder with a discovery file in it, which is easy to create and hard to keep track of: which ones exist, which are currently switched off (a renamed file is invisible, not absent), which one has a broken frontmatter, and which are duplicates across the two writable roots. This plugin is the one place that answers those questions, without an editor open and without hand-renaming files.

**Enabled is the default, and disabling is a filesystem fact first.** The discovery file is renamed (`SKILL.md` → `SKILL.md.disabled`, or `<name>.md` → `<name>.md.disabled`) so the filesystem provider simply stops seeing it; a registry record is what lets the panel still list it and switch it back on.

## Screenshots

![The Skills panel: the flat profile inventory](docs/images/skills-panel.png)

*Skills — one flat table over the profile inventory (enabled and disabled alike), with search, a source filter, use-count and last-used chips, the discovery diagnostics and the restorable trash.*

![The detail view of one skill](docs/images/skill-detail.png)

*Inspect — the skill's body and metadata, with the enable/disable action for a disabled skill.*

## The registry file

```
<profile>/.dsh/dshsk/skills.json      the profile's skill management state
```

One registry holds everything the manager persists: the disabled-skill records, the trash, and the statistics checkpoint. It is reconciled at startup — a `.disabled` file with no record is adopted (an upgraded or hand-edited install), and a record whose file is gone is dropped. Writes go through an atomic same-directory temp file (`wx`, mode `0600`, then `rename`), and a read that hits unparsable JSON refuses to overwrite it and reports why.

## Features

| Surface | What it does |
|---|---|
| Sidebar row | sits directly under **Plugins** (`order: 1`) and opens the **Skills** page in the centre column |
| Skills table | one flat table of the profile inventory — Name / Source / Description / Status / Actions — with search, sorting and a source filter |
| Enable / disable | renames the discovery file and keeps the record, so the row stays visible (dimmed) and can be switched back on |
| Inspect | reads a skill's body and metadata without leaving the GUI |
| Add skill | scaffolds a new skill in a writable root |
| Discovery diagnostics | lists the skills the provider cannot see, and auto-fixes the repairable ones in place |
| Restorable trash | `Delete` moves a skill into the root's `.trash`; the panel lists it with a Restore action, and clearing the trash is explicit |
| Chat `/` menu dots | marks each candidate row as model-invocable or user-invocable, coloured from the same settings the panel reads |
| Settings card | the plugin's own configuration, in the Plugins manager |
| Attribution | the title chip carries the installed version and the author credit |

## Requirements

- Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`
- A DeepSeek Harness `0.2.0-rc.2` installation (the plugin composes into a profile)
- `pnpm` 11.8.0 (`packageManager` in the manifest pins it)

## Installation

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm check                        # typecheck → build → tests → verifiers
pnpm pack                         # dist/dsh-skill-mgr-<version>.tgz
sh tools/install-into-profile.sh desktop
```

Restart DeepSeek Harness afterwards; the sidebar entry appears directly under **Plugins**.

The package is not on npm: the profile installs it from this repository. `dsh plugin` (a pnpm passthrough into the profile directory) is what the script uses, and the Plugins page does the same thing. The desktop profile is owned by the Electron application, so `dsh --profile desktop` itself refuses to compose it, while `dsh plugin` still works.

Upgrading from `dsh-skill-hub`? The two packages must not both be installed — they would both claim the plugin-config card. Remove the old bundle first; the new plugin adopts the old state file on its first load and leaves it untouched.

## Quick start

1. Open **Skills** in the sidebar. The table lists every skill in `~/.dsh/skills` and `~/.agents/skills`.
2. Search for a skill; select **Inspect** to read it, or **Disable** to switch it off for the whole profile.
3. Select **Add skill** to scaffold a new one in a writable root.
4. Read the diagnostics banner when something is not being discovered, and use its fix action on the repairable entries.

## Configuration

The Loader entry's config is the settings card; the host reads the same values through their volatile refs.

| Field | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | contribute the skill provider and the announcement; the management panel keeps working either way, because it is the surface that turns the plugin back on |
| `announceToAgent` | `true` | register the system-prompt section that tells an agent this manager exists |
| `showUseCount` | `true` | per-skill invocation-count chip |
| `showUseTime` | `true` | per-skill last-used relative time |
| `dotModelColor` | unset | `#rrggbb` for the "model-invocable" dot, in the table and the chat `/` menu |
| `dotUserColor` | unset | `#rrggbb` for the "user-invocable only" dot |
| `statsWindowDays` | `14` | rolling window for the counts; `0` = all history |
| `statsScanMinutes` | `5` | background session-log scan interval, in minutes |

## Remote surface

The browser half reads and writes through one Typert Remote namespace, `skillMgr`. Two conventions cover the whole surface: `snapshot()` is the one read (the panel loads all of its slices from a single call, cached for one render pass), and every write answers `SkillApplyResult` (`{ok:true}` / `{ok:false, error}`) after which the caller refetches.

| Area | Methods |
|---|---|
| Core | `snapshot` |
| Profile inventory | `saveGlobalSkill`, `removeGlobalSkill`, `setGlobalSkillEnabled`, `skillDetail`, `fixDiagnostic`, `skillStats` |
| Trash | `restoreTrashedSkill`, `clearTrash` |

Nine methods in total. Their parameter and result types live in `src/wire.ts` as zod schemas, and each type is `z.infer` of its schema, so the host implementation, the descriptors and the browser half cannot drift apart.

## Caveats

- **Enable/disable is profile-wide, not per workspace.** Because toggling renames one discovery file, there is no way to have a skill on in one workspace and off in another; every workspace is offered every skill in the profile inventory. A reader who needs per-workspace on/off cannot have it here.
- **Project skills are discovered, not managed.** The provider lists a workspace's own roots so an agent still sees the skills beside it, but they are never part of the profile inventory the panel manages: they cannot be toggled, deleted or adopted. Onl
